# Definitions

```{r setup, include=FALSE}

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

here::i_am("co2_study_analysis.Rmd")

theme_set(cowplot::theme_half_open() +
            theme(legend.spacing.x = unit(3, "mm"),
                  strip.background = element_blank(),
                  panel.spacing = unit(5, "mm")))

photosynthetic_types <- readxl::read_xlsx(here::here("data", "photosynthetic_types.xlsx")) %>%
  mutate(Species = paste(stringr::str_sub(Species, 1, 1), stringr::word(Species, 2), sep = ". "),
         PhotosyntheticType = PhotosyntheticType %>% stringr::str_replace("(\\d)", "[\\1]"),
         PhotosyntheticType = ifelse(stringr::str_detect(PhotosyntheticType, "-"), "`sub-`*C[2]", PhotosyntheticType),
         PhotosyntheticType = factor(PhotosyntheticType, levels = c("C[3]", "PK", "`sub-`*C[2]", "C[2]")))

SP_BREAKS <- c("F. cronquistii","H. glutinosa", "F. pringlei", "T. forrestii",
               "S. laxum", "H. isocalycia", "F. sonorensis", "F. angustifolia", 
               "T. cristatus", "H. aturensis", "S. hians")

# Model-fit summary helpers (tidy_fit, summarise_fit_set)
tidy_fit <- function(f) {
  empty <- tibble::tibble(Term = NA_character_, Estimate = NA_real_,
                          SE = NA_real_, stat = NA_real_, p = NA_real_)
  if (is.null(f)) return(empty)
  if (inherits(f, "gls")) {
    tt <- tryCatch(summary(f)$tTable, error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(tt)) return(empty)
    tibble::tibble(Term = rownames(tt), Estimate = tt[, "Value"], SE = tt[, "Std.Error"],
                   stat = tt[, "t-value"], p = tt[, "p-value"])
  } else {
    tt <- summary(f)$coefficients
    tibble::tibble(Term = rownames(tt), Estimate = tt[, "Estimate"], SE = tt[, "Std. Error"],
                   stat = tt[, "t value"], p = tt[, "Pr(>|t|)"])
  }
}

summarise_fit_set <- function(fits, parsimony_dAIC = 2) {
  aic    <- vapply(fits, function(f) if (is.null(f)) NA_real_ else AIC(f), numeric(1))
  npar   <- vapply(fits, function(f) if (is.null(f)) NA_integer_ else length(coef(f)), integer(1))
  finite <- is.finite(aic)
  min_aic <- if (any(finite)) min(aic[finite]) else NA_real_
  dAIC   <- ifelse(finite, aic - min_aic, NA_real_)

  coefs <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(names(fits),
                                   function(nm) dplyr::mutate(tidy_fit(fits[[nm]]), Model = nm)))

  meta <- tibble::tibble(Model = names(fits), nPar = npar,
                         AIC = round(aic, 2), dAIC = round(dAIC, 2), Finite = finite)
  tab <- meta %>%
    dplyr::left_join(coefs, by = "Model") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Estimate = round(Estimate, 4), SE = round(SE, 4),
                  stat = round(stat, 2), p = signif(p, 3)) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(Finite), AIC, Model)

  # Simplest (fewest parameters) among finite fits within parsimony_dAIC of the best.
  best_name <- meta %>%
    dplyr::filter(Finite, dAIC <= parsimony_dAIC) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(nPar, AIC) %>%
    dplyr::slice(1) %>% dplyr::pull(Model)
  if (length(best_name) == 0) best_name <- NA_character_

  list(table = tab, best_name = best_name, meta = meta, aic = aic)
}

```

```{r aci}
  mutate(PARi = as.factor(PARi))

cstar_aci_plot_data <- cstar_aci_data %>%
  group_by(Species, Plant, GrowthCO2ppm, PARi, Obs) %>%
  summarise(across(.cols = c("Photo", "Ci"),
                   .fns = mean)) %>%
  group_by(Species, GrowthCO2ppm, PARi, Obs) %>%
  summarise(across(.cols = c("Photo", "Ci"),
                   .fns = list(Mean = mean,
                               SE = ~sd(.)/sqrt(n())))) %>%

  mutate(
    Species = factor(Species, levels = SP_BREAKS),

  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.25, color = "black") +
```

## Slope-intercept


```{r slopes}

cstar_aci_data <- readr::read_csv(here::here("data", "gas_ex", "merged_gas_ex_cstar.csv"))

slope_data <- cstar_aci_data %>%
  anti_join(filter_antijoin) %>%
  group_by(Species, Plant, GrowthCO2ppm, PARi, Obs) %>%
  summarise(across(.cols = c("Photo", "Ci"),
                   .fns = mean)) %>%
  group_by(Species, Plant, GrowthCO2ppm, PARi) %>%
  do(lm = broom::tidy(lm(Photo ~ Ci, data = .))) %>% # Slopes and intercepts at each PAR
  tidyr::unnest(lm) %>%
  mutate(term = stringr::str_replace(term, stringr::regex("[:punct:]Intercept[:punct:]"), "Intercept")) %>%
  mutate(term = stringr::str_replace(term, "Ci", "Slope")) %>%
  dplyr::select(!c(std.error, statistic, p.value)) %>% # we're just looking for the slope and intercept
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = "term", values_from = "estimate") 

filtered_slope_data <- slope_data %>%
  full_join(photosynthetic_types) %>%
  filter(!(Species %in% c("F. sonorensis", "F. angustifolia", "T. cristatus") & PARi %in% c(1500))) %>%
  filter(!(Species %in% c("H. aturensis", "S. hians") & PARi %in% c(400, 1500)))


gammas <- slope_data %>%
  filter(PARi == 1500) %>%
  group_by(Species, Plant, GrowthCO2ppm) %>%
  summarise(across(.cols = c("Intercept", "Slope"),
                   .fns = mean)) %>%
  mutate(Gamma = -Intercept/Slope)

gammas_lowlight <- slope_data %>%
  filter(PARi == 250) %>%
  group_by(Species, Plant, GrowthCO2ppm) %>%
  summarise(across(.cols = c("Intercept", "Slope"),
                   .fns = mean)) %>%
  mutate(Gamma = -Intercept/Slope)

cstars <- filtered_slope_data %>%
  group_by(Species, Plant, GrowthCO2ppm) %>%
  do(lm = broom::tidy(lm(Intercept ~ Slope, data = .))) %>%
  tidyr::unnest(lm) %>%
  mutate(term = stringr::str_replace(term, stringr::regex("[:punct:]Intercept[:punct:]"), "Intercept")) %>%
  mutate(term = stringr::str_replace(term, "Ci", "Slope")) %>%
  dplyr::select(!c(std.error, statistic, p.value)) %>% # we're just looking for the slope and intercept
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = "term", values_from = "estimate") %>%
  rename(Rd = Intercept) %>%
  mutate(Cstar = -Slope)

slope_plot_data <- slope_data %>%
  group_by(Species, Plant, GrowthCO2ppm, PARi) %>%
  summarise(across(.cols = c("Intercept", "Slope"),
                   .fns = mean)) %>%
  group_by(Species, GrowthCO2ppm, PARi) %>%
  summarise(across(.cols = c("Intercept", "Slope"),
                   .fns = list(Mean = mean,
                               SE = ~sd(.)/sqrt(n())))) %>%
  mutate(
    Species = factor(Species, levels = SP_BREAKS),
    SpeciesLabel = factor(
      paste0("italic(\"", Species, "\")"),
      levels = paste0("italic(\"", SP_BREAKS, "\")")
  ))

filtered_slope_plot_data <- slope_plot_data %>%
  full_join(photosynthetic_types) %>%
  filter(!(Species %in% c("F. sonorensis", "F. angustifolia", "T. cristatus") & PARi %in% c(1500))) %>%
  filter(!(Species %in% c("H. aturensis", "S. hians") & PARi %in% c(400, 1500)))

# Per-facet equation and R2
slope_eq_labels <- filtered_slope_plot_data %>%
  dplyr::group_by(SpeciesLabel, GrowthCO2ppm) %>%
  dplyr::group_modify(~ {
    if (sum(stats::complete.cases(.x$Slope_Mean, .x$Intercept_Mean)) < 3) {
      return(tibble::tibble())
    }
    fm <- stats::lm(Intercept_Mean ~ Slope_Mean, data = .x)
    tibble::tibble(b0 = stats::coef(fm)[1],
                   b1 = stats::coef(fm)[2],
                   r2 = summary(fm)$r.squared)
  }) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(label = sprintf(
    "italic(y)~`=`~%.2f~%s~%.2f*italic(x)*`,`~italic(R)^2~`=`~%.2f",
    b0, ifelse(b1 < 0, "-", "+"), abs(b1), r2))

slope_plot <- ggplot(slope_plot_data,
                     aes(x = Slope_Mean, y = Intercept_Mean)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = Slope_Mean-Slope_SE, xmax = Slope_Mean+Slope_SE),
                linewidth = 0.25) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Intercept_Mean-Intercept_SE, ymax = Intercept_Mean+Intercept_SE),
                linewidth = 0.25)  +
  geom_smooth(data = filtered_slope_plot_data,
              method = "lm", 
              se = FALSE,  
              fullrange = TRUE,
              linewidth = 0.25,
              color = "black") +
  geom_point(aes(fill = as.factor(PARi)),
             shape = 21) +
  geom_text(data = slope_eq_labels,
            aes(x = 0.195, y = -14.6, label = label),
            parse = TRUE, size = 3, hjust = 1, vjust = 0, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 0.2), breaks = seq(0, 0.2, 0.05), expand = expansion()) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-15, 0), breaks = seq(-15, 0, 3), expand = expansion()) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#3B528B", "#6C7DA8", "#9DA9C5", "#CED4E2", "#FFFFFF"),
                    name = expression(PPFD~"("*µmol~m^-2~s^-1*")")) +
  labs(y = expression("y-intercept of A/"*italic(C[i])~"response ("*µmol~m^-2~s^-1*")"),
       x = expression("Initial slope of A/"*italic(C[i])~"response ("*mol~m^-2~s^-1*")")) +
  # cowplot::panel_border(size = 0.5, color = "black") +
  ggh4x::facet_wrap2(SpeciesLabel ~ GrowthCO2ppm, axes = "all", ncol = 4, labeller = "label_parsed")

# Fig. S2 facet tags: one per panel, in facet order (species by SP_BREAKS, then 200 before 800)
slope_all_tags <- slope_plot_data %>%
  ungroup() %>% # slope_plot_data is still grouped after summarise(); without this row_number() restarts per group
  distinct(SpeciesLabel, GrowthCO2ppm) %>%
  arrange(SpeciesLabel, GrowthCO2ppm) %>%
  mutate(tag = paste0("(", letters[row_number()], ")"))
slope_plot <- slope_plot +
  geom_text(data = slope_all_tags,
            aes(x = 0.195, y = -0.5, label = tag), # top right; the regression line runs through the top left
            inherit.aes = FALSE,
            fontface = "bold", size = 12 / .pt, hjust = 1, vjust = 1)
slope_plot

ggsave(here::here("figures/gas_ex", "slope_intercept_all.tif"), slope_plot, width = 12, height = 15, bg = "white", dpi = 500)
ggsave(here::here("figures/gas_ex", "slope_intercept_all.jpg"), slope_plot, width = 12, height = 15, bg = "white", dpi = 500)
```

## Gamma/PPFD

``` {r gamma_ppfd}
gammas_ppfd <- slope_data %>%
  mutate(PARi = as.numeric(as.character(PARi)),
         GrowthCO2ppm = as.factor(GrowthCO2ppm)) %>%
  mutate(Gamma = -Intercept/Slope) %>% 
  filter(Gamma > 0) %>%
  group_by(Species, GrowthCO2ppm, PARi) %>%
  summarise(across(.cols = "Gamma",
                   .fns = list(n = ~n(),
                               Mean = mean,
                               SE = ~sd(.)/sqrt(n())))) %>%
  full_join(photosynthetic_types)

fitted_coeffs <- gammas_ppfd %>%
  group_by(GrowthCO2ppm, PhotosyntheticType) %>%
  tidyr::nest() %>%
  mutate(
    fit = purrr::map(data, ~ nls(Gamma_Mean ~ k/(PARi + a) + b,
                          data = .x,
                          start = list(a = 5, b = 50, k = 1000))),
    tidied = purrr::map(fit, broom::tidy),        # coefficients
    equation = purrr::map(fit, ~ {
      coefs <- coef(.x)
      paste0("Gamma = ", round(coefs["k"],2), "/(PAR + ", round(coefs["a"],2), ") + ", round(coefs["b"],2))
    })
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(GrowthCO2ppm, tidied, equation) %>%
  tidyr::unnest(tidied) %>%
  mutate(equation = equation %>% as.character())
fitted_coeffs

writexl::write_xlsx(fitted_coeffs, here::here("figures/gas_ex", "gamma_ppfd_plot_coeffs.xlsx"))

#####

gammas_ppfd %>%
  tidyr::nest(data = -PhotosyntheticType) %>%
  mutate(
    model = purrr::map(data, ~ lm(Gamma_Mean ~ I(1/PARi) +GrowthCO2ppm, data = .x)),
    tidy   = purrr::map(model, broom::tidy)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(PhotosyntheticType, tidy) %>%
  tidyr::unnest(tidy)
gamma_ppfd_plot <- gammas_ppfd %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = PARi, y = Gamma_Mean, shape = GrowthCO2ppm, 
             fill = GrowthCO2ppm, linetype = GrowthCO2ppm)) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "nls",
    formula = y ~ k/(x + a) + b,
    method.args = list(start = c(a = 5, b = 50, k = 1000)),
    se = FALSE,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Gamma_Mean-Gamma_SE, ymax = Gamma_Mean+Gamma_SE),
                linewidth = 0.25,
                linetype = "solid",
                width = 0) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5) +
  # ggpmisc::stat_poly_eq(ggpmisc::use_label(labels = c("rr", "p")),
  #                       formula = y ~ I(1/x),
  #                       method = "lm",
  #                       label.x = "right",
  #                       label.y = "top") +
  labs(x = expression("Photosynthetic photon flux density"~"("*µmol~m^-2~s^-1*")"),
       y = expression(italic(Γ)~"("*µmol~mol^-1*")"),
       fill = expression(italic(C)[growth]~"(" * µmol ~ mol^-1 * ")"),
       shape = expression(italic(C)[growth]~"(" * µmol ~ mol^-1 * ")"),
       linetype = expression(italic(C)[growth]~"(" * µmol ~ mol^-1 * ")")) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(21, 22)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("black", "white")) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1700), breaks = seq(0, 1500, 500), expand = expansion()) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-10, 160), breaks = seq(0, 160, 40), expand = expansion()) +
  # cowplot::panel_border(size = 0.5, color = "black") +
  coord_cartesian(expand = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~ PhotosyntheticType, labeller = label_parsed, nrow = 1)
```

``` {r cstar_stats}


cstars <- readr::read_csv(here::here("data/processed_data/cstars.csv")) 
# Slope of the A/Ci response fitted at PARi = 1500 (units mol m-2 s-1)
gammas <- readr::read_csv(here::here("data/processed_data/gammas.csv")) %>%
  rename(InitialSlope = Slope)
gammas_lowlight <- readr::read_csv(here::here("data/processed_data/gammas_lowlight.csv")) %>%
  rename(GammaLowLight = Gamma,
         InitialSlopeLowLight = Slope)

cstar_gamma_rep_data <- full_join(cstars %>% dplyr::select(Species, Plant, GrowthCO2ppm, Cstar, Rd), 
                                  gammas %>% dplyr::select(Species, Plant, GrowthCO2ppm, Gamma, InitialSlope)) %>%
  full_join(gammas_lowlight %>% dplyr::select(Species, Plant, GrowthCO2ppm, GammaLowLight)) %>%
  left_join(photosynthetic_types) %>%
  mutate(SpeciesLabel = paste(stringr::str_sub(Species, 1, 1),
                              stringr::word(Species, 2) %>% stringr::str_sub(1, 4),
                              sep = "."),
         ID = stringr::str_c(SpeciesLabel, Plant),
         GrowthCO2ppm = as.factor(GrowthCO2ppm))

cstar_gamma_data <- cstar_gamma_rep_data %>%
  group_by(PhotosyntheticType, Species, GrowthCO2ppm) %>%
  summarise(across(.cols = c("Gamma", "GammaLowLight", "Cstar", "Rd", "InitialSlope"),
                   .fns = list(Mean = mean,
                               SE = ~sd(.)/sqrt(n())))) %>%
  mutate(SpeciesLabel = paste(stringr::str_sub(Species, 1, 1),
                              stringr::word(Species, 2) %>% stringr::str_sub(1, 4),
                              sep = "."),
         GrowthCO2ppm = as.factor(GrowthCO2ppm))

cstar_gamma_table <- cstar_gamma_letters %>%

  mutate(Species = factor(Species, levels = SP_BREAKS),

                          "Gamma_Mean","Gamma_SE",

                .fns = ~ sprintf("%.1f", plyr::round_any(.x, 0.1))),
         Rd_Mean = -1*Rd_Mean,
         across(.cols = c("Rd_Mean","Rd_SE"),
                .fns = ~ sprintf("%.2f", plyr::round_any(.x, 0.01))),

         GammaLowLight = paste0(GammaLowLight_Mean, " ± ", GammaLowLight_SE, GammaLowLightLetter),
         Cstar = paste0(Cstar_Mean, " ± ", Cstar_SE, CstarLetter),
         InitialSlope = paste0(InitialSlope_Mean, " ± ", InitialSlope_SE, InitialSlopeLetter),
         Rd = paste0(Rd_Mean, " ± ", Rd_SE, RdLetter),
         .keep = "unused") %>%
  dplyr::select(Species, GrowthCO2ppm, Gamma, GammaLowLight, Cstar, InitialSlope, Rd) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = "GrowthCO2ppm",
                     values_from = c("Gamma", "GammaLowLight", "Cstar", "InitialSlope", "Rd")) %>%
  arrange(Species)
```

# Enzyme activity analysis


## Example F.angustifolia traces

```{r ex}

library(ggtext)

# Constants for rate calculation
TUBE_BUFFER_VOL <- 0.9
CUVETTE_BUFFER_VOL <- 0.686
CUVETTE_TOTAL_VOLUME <- 0.7
LEAF_SAMPLE_VOLUME <- 0.05
EXTINCTION_COEFF <- 6.22

merged_filter <- readr::read_csv(here::here("data/processed_data/merged_filtered_spec.csv"))

area <- readxl::read_xlsx(here::here("data/enzyme/EnzymeLeafAreas.xlsx")) %>%
  mutate(FileID = stringr::str_extract(Filename, "[:digit:]+") %>% as.numeric(),
         LeafArea = Area,
         .keep = "unused") %>%
  dplyr::select(Folder, FileID, LeafArea, ExtractionBufferVolume)

sp_names <- readxl::read_xlsx(here::here("data/enzyme/Leaf freezing merged.xlsx")) %>%
  mutate(Species = stringr::str_c(stringr::word(Species, 1) %>% stringr::str_sub(1, 1), stringr::word(Species, 2), sep = ". "),
         CO2 = ifelse(stringr::str_detect(PlantID, "HC"), 800, 200)) %>%
  rename(FileID = SampleID)

chl_area_means <- readxl::read_xlsx(here::here("data/processed_data/enzyme_activites.xlsx")) %>%
  distinct(Folder, FileID, Chl_mg_m2_mean, Chl_mol_m2_mean, Chl_mmol_m2_mean, Chl_ab_ratio_mol_mean) %>%
  filter(is.finite(Chl_mg_m2_mean))

# 1. Join and filter data
merged_ex <- full_join(merged_filter, area, by = c("Folder", "FileID")) %>%
  full_join(chl_area_means) %>%
  full_join(sp_names) %>%
  filter(Species == "F. angustifolia" & 
           Enzyme == "Asp-AT" & 
           Time <= 90) %>%
  mutate(CO2 = factor(CO2, levels = c(200, 800)),
         Time_Rel = Time - 31) # Normalize time so start is 0

# 2. Calculate the Intercept for EACH technical replicate
# We use a linear model for each rep to find exactly where it hits Time_Rel = 0
intercepts <- merged_ex %>%
  group_by(CO2, PlantID, TechnicalRep) %>%
  do(model = lm(Absorbance ~ Time_Rel, data = .)) %>%
  mutate(Abs_Intercept = model$coefficients[1]) %>%
  dplyr::select(-model)

# 3. Shift the data and calculate concentrations
merged_ex_shifted <- merged_ex %>%
  left_join(intercepts, by = c("CO2", "PlantID", "TechnicalRep")) %>%
  mutate(
    # SHIFT LOGIC: Substract the intercept to force through zero
    Abs_Shifted = Absorbance - Abs_Intercept,
    
    # Calculate concentrations using the shifted Absorbance
    # We use Abs_Shifted * -1 because NADH consumption is a negative slope
    NADH_umol_area = (((-1 * Abs_Shifted / LeafArea) * 10^4) / EXTINCTION_COEFF) *
                     (CUVETTE_TOTAL_VOLUME / CUVETTE_BUFFER_VOL) *
                     (TUBE_BUFFER_VOL / LEAF_SAMPLE_VOLUME) *
                     ExtractionBufferVolume,
    NADH_umol_mgchl = NADH_umol_area / Chl_mg_m2_mean,
    NADH_mmol_molchl = (NADH_umol_area / Chl_mol_m2_mean) / 10^3   # mmol (mol Chl)-1
  )

# 4. Summarize for plotting (Mean and SE across biological replicates)
merged_ex_plot_data <- merged_ex_shifted %>%
  group_by(CO2, Time_Rel) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean_NADH = mean(NADH_mmol_molchl, na.rm = TRUE),
    SE_NADH = sd(NADH_mmol_molchl, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 5. Trace Plot
trace_plot_ex <- ggplot(merged_ex_plot_data, 
                        aes(x = Time_Rel, y = Mean_NADH,
                            shape = CO2, fill = CO2)) +
  # Force the smooth through origin by formula y ~ x + 0
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", 
              fullrange = TRUE,
              formula = y ~ x + 0, 
              se = FALSE, 
              color = "black",
              linewidth = 0.25) + 
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Mean_NADH - SE_NADH, ymax = Mean_NADH + SE_NADH), 
                width = 0,
                linewidth = 0.25) +
  geom_point(size = 1.2) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 60), expand = expansion(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, NA), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) + # was c(0, 7) on the ug mg Chl-1 basis; ~x900 on the mmol mol Chl-1 basis, set once values are seen
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("black", "white")) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(21, 22)) +
  xlab("Time post-trigger (s)") +
  ylab("NADH oxidized<br>(mmol mol Chl<sup>-1</sup>)<br>") +
  # facet_wrap(~ CO2, ncol = 1, scales = "free") +
  facet_wrap(~ CO2, nrow = 1, scales = "free") +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        panel.spacing = unit(5,"mm"),
        axis.title.y = element_textbox_simple(orientation = "left-rotated", halign = 0.5))

trace_plot_ex


ggsave(here::here("figures/biochem", "spec_trace.jpg"), trace_plot_ex, width = 6, height = 3, bg = "white", dpi = 500)
```

```{r plots}
#####
chlrates_area_letters <- chlrates_sp %>%
  group_by(Species, GrowthCO2ppm, Enzyme, Plant) %>%
  mutate(Rateumol_area = mean(Rateumol_area)) %>%
  group_by(Species, Enzyme) %>%
  rstatix::t_test(Rateumol_area ~ GrowthCO2ppm, alternative = "greater",
                  p.adjust.method = "none") %>%
  mutate(AreaLetter = case_when(p < 0.05 ~ "*", 
                               p < 0.08 ~ "^",
                               .default = "")) %>%
  dplyr::select(Species, Enzyme, AreaLetter)

chlrates_chl_test <- chlrates_sp %>%
  group_by(Species, GrowthCO2ppm, Enzyme, Plant) %>%
  mutate(Rateumol_mgchl_h = mean(Rateumol_mgchl_h))  %>%
  group_by(Species, Enzyme) %>%
  rstatix::t_test(Rateumol_mgchl_h ~ GrowthCO2ppm, alternative = "greater",
                  p.adjust.method = "none")
chlrates_chl_letters <- chlrates_chl_test %>%
  mutate(ChlLetter = case_when(p < 0.05 ~ "*",
                               p < 0.08 ~ "^",
                               .default = "")) %>%
  dplyr::select(Species, Enzyme, ChlLetter)

# mmol (mol Chl)-1 s-1 basis, same test structure as the mg Chl basis
chlrates_mol_test <- chlrates_sp %>%
  group_by(Species, GrowthCO2ppm, Enzyme, Plant) %>%
  mutate(Rate_mmol_molchl_s = mean(Rate_mmol_molchl_s))  %>%
  group_by(Species, Enzyme) %>%
  rstatix::t_test(Rate_mmol_molchl_s ~ GrowthCO2ppm, alternative = "greater",
                  p.adjust.method = "none")
chlrates_mol_letters <- chlrates_mol_test %>%
  mutate(MolLetter = case_when(p < 0.05 ~ "*",
                               p < 0.08 ~ "^",
                               .default = "")) %>%
  dplyr::select(Species, Enzyme, MolLetter)

# ---- Check: do the mg Chl and mol Chl bases give the same statistical result? ----
# The two bases differ only by a per-sample factor (Chl_ab / Chl_ab_ug, i.e. the mean molar
# mass of the Chl a+b pool, which moves with Chl a:b). Identical a:b within a species
# would make the tests identical; differences arise where a:b differs between plants.
chl_basis_check <- chlrates_chl_test %>%
  dplyr::select(Species, Enzyme, p_mgchl = p, t_mgchl = statistic) %>%
  full_join(chlrates_mol_test %>%
              dplyr::select(Species, Enzyme, p_molchl = p, t_molchl = statistic),
            by = c("Species", "Enzyme")) %>%
  full_join(chlrates_chl_letters, by = c("Species", "Enzyme")) %>%
  full_join(chlrates_mol_letters, by = c("Species", "Enzyme")) %>%
  mutate(SameLetter = ChlLetter == MolLetter,
         dp = p_molchl - p_mgchl)
if (!all(chl_basis_check$SameLetter)) {
  print(chl_basis_check %>% filter(!SameLetter) %>%
          dplyr::select(Species, Enzyme, p_mgchl, p_molchl, ChlLetter, MolLetter))
}
readr::write_csv(chl_basis_check, here::here("data/processed_data/chl_basis_check.csv"))

chlrates_summary <- chlrates_sp %>%
  group_by(Species, Enzyme, GrowthCO2ppm) %>%
  summarise(across(.cols = c(Rateumol_mgchl_h, Rate_mmol_molchl_s, Rateumol_area),
                   .fns = list(n = length,
                               mean = mean,
                               se = ~sd(.)/sqrt(length(.))))) %>%
  full_join(photosynthetic_types) %>%
  full_join(chlrates_area_letters) %>%
  full_join(chlrates_chl_letters) %>%
  full_join(chlrates_mol_letters) %>%
  mutate(Species = factor(Species, levels = SP_BREAKS))
```

``` {r table}
area <-readxl::read_xlsx(here::here("data/enzyme/EnzymeLeafAreas.xlsx")) %>%
  mutate(FileID = stringr::str_extract(Filename, "[:digit:]+") %>% as.numeric(),
         LeafArea = Area,
         .keep = "unused") %>%
  dplyr::select(Folder, FileID, LeafArea, ExtractionBufferVolume)


sp_names <- readxl::read_xlsx(here::here("data/enzyme/Leaf freezing merged.xlsx")) %>%
  mutate(Species = stringr::str_c(stringr::word(Species, 1) %>% stringr::str_sub(1, 1), stringr::word(Species, 2), sep = ". "),
         CO2 = ifelse(stringr::str_detect(PlantID, "HC"), 800, 200)) %>%
  rename(FileID = SampleID)

chl_ab_ratio_sp <- area %>%
  full_join(chl) %>%
  full_join(sp_names) %>%
  group_by(Species, CO2, PlantID) %>%
  mutate(Chl_ab_ratio_mol = mean(Chl_ab_ratio_mol, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  distinct(Species, CO2, PlantID, Chl_ab_ratio_mol)

chl_ab_ratio_summary <- chl_ab_ratio_sp %>%
  group_by(Species, CO2) %>%
  summarise(across(.cols = Chl_ab_ratio_mol,
                   .fns = list(#n = length,
                               mean = mean,
                               se = ~sd(.)/sqrt(length(.))))) %>%
  na.omit
  

chl_ab_ratio_letters <- chl_ab_ratio_sp %>%
  filter(!is.na(Species)) %>%
  group_by(Species) %>%
  rstatix::t_test(Chl_ab_ratio_mol ~ CO2, alternative = "greater",
                  p.adjust.method = "none") %>%
  mutate(Chl_ab_ratio_molLetter = case_when(p < 0.05 ~ "*", 
                               p < 0.08 ~ "^",
                               .default = "")) %>%
  dplyr::select(Species, Chl_ab_ratio_molLetter)

chl_ab_ratio_table <- chl_ab_ratio_summary %>%
  full_join(chl_ab_ratio_letters) %>%
  mutate(Species = factor(Species, levels = SP_BREAKS),
         across(.cols = c("Chl_ab_ratio_mol_mean","Chl_ab_ratio_mol_se"),
                .fns = ~ sprintf("%.2f", plyr::round_any(.x, 0.01)))) %>%
  mutate(Chl_ab_ratio_mol = paste0(Chl_ab_ratio_mol_mean, " ± ", Chl_ab_ratio_mol_se, Chl_ab_ratio_molLetter),
         .keep = "unused") %>%
  dplyr::select(Species, CO2, Chl_ab_ratio_mol) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = "CO2",
                     values_from = "Chl_ab_ratio_mol",
                     names_glue = "{.value}_{CO2}") %>%
  arrange(Species)

##### Supplementary: Chl content per leaf area (mmol m-2 and mg m-2), one value per plant

chl_content_sp <- chl_area %>%
  full_join(sp_names) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Species)) %>%
  group_by(Species, CO2, PlantID) %>%
  summarise(Chl_mmol_m2 = mean(Chl_mmol_m2, na.rm = TRUE),
            Chl_mg_m2 = mean(Chl_mg_m2, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")

chl_content_summary <- chl_content_sp %>%
  group_by(Species, CO2) %>%
  summarise(across(.cols = c(Chl_mmol_m2, Chl_mg_m2),
                   .fns = list(n = length,
                               mean = mean,
                               se = ~sd(.)/sqrt(length(.)))),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  na.omit()

chl_content_letters <- chl_content_sp %>%
  group_by(Species) %>%
  rstatix::t_test(Chl_mmol_m2 ~ CO2, alternative = "two.sided",
                  p.adjust.method = "none") %>%
  mutate(ChlContentLetter = case_when(p < 0.05 ~ "*",
                                      p < 0.08 ~ "^",
                                      .default = "")) %>%
  dplyr::select(Species, ChlContentLetter)

chl_content_table <- chl_content_summary %>%
  full_join(chl_content_letters) %>%
  mutate(Species = factor(Species, levels = SP_BREAKS),
         Chl_mmol_m2 = paste0(sprintf("%.2f", Chl_mmol_m2_mean), " ± ",
                              sprintf("%.2f", Chl_mmol_m2_se), ChlContentLetter),
         Chl_mg_m2 = paste0(sprintf("%.0f", Chl_mg_m2_mean), " ± ",
                            sprintf("%.0f", Chl_mg_m2_se), ChlContentLetter),
         n = Chl_mmol_m2_n) %>%
  dplyr::select(Species, CO2, n, Chl_mmol_m2, Chl_mg_m2) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = "CO2",
                     values_from = c("n", "Chl_mmol_m2", "Chl_mg_m2"),
                     names_glue = "{.value}_{CO2}") %>%
  arrange(Species)
```

``` {r loadanatomy}
bs_dot_data <- readxl::read_xlsx(here::here("../TEM/ImmunoMEasurements.xlsx"), sheet = "BS Dots") %>%
  tidyr::fill(Species, Plant, CO2, Cell) %>%
  filter(!is.na(AreaMito) & !is.na(Mito)) %>%
  group_by(Species, Plant, CO2, Cell) %>%
  mutate(AreaMito = AreaMito/(1.25)^2) %>%
  summarise(DotsPerMitoArea = ifelse(is.na(sum(DotsBkg, na.rm = TRUE)),
                                     sum(DotsMito, na.rm = TRUE)/sum(AreaMito, na.rm = TRUE)-sum(DotsBkg, na.rm = TRUE)/sum(AreaBkg, na.rm = TRUE),
                                     sum(DotsMito, na.rm = TRUE)/sum(AreaMito, na.rm = TRUE)))
m_dot_data <- readxl::read_xlsx(here::here("../TEM/ImmunoMEasurements.xlsx"), sheet = "M Dots") %>%
  tidyr::fill(Species, Plant, CO2, Cell) %>%
  filter(!is.na(AreaMito) & !is.na(Mito)) %>%
  group_by(Species, Plant, CO2, Cell) %>%
  mutate(AreaMito = AreaMito/(1.25)^2) %>%
  summarise(DotsPerMitoAreaM = sum(DotsMito, na.rm = TRUE)/sum(AreaMito, na.rm = TRUE))
dot_data <- full_join(bs_dot_data, m_dot_data)

immuno_data <- full_join(organelle_data, dot_data) %>%
  group_by(Species, Plant, CO2) %>%
  summarise(across(.cols = c(starts_with(c("Area", "Dots", "n")), "VacuolePARatio", "VacuoleCircularity", "VacuoleSolidity",
                             "MitoChloroEdgeDist", "MitoChloroCentroidDist", "ChloroMitoEdgeDist", "ChloroMitoCentroidDist"),
                   .fns = ~ mean(., na.rm = TRUE))) %>%
  mutate(ChloroSize = AreaChloro/nChloro,
         MitoSize = AreaMito/nMito)

# Calculations for tissue-level traits
allocation_data <- full_join(immuno_data, lm_data) %>%
  right_join(photosynthetic_types, .) %>%
  filter(Species != "NA") %>%
  mutate(CO2 = as.factor(CO2)) %>%
  mutate(BSFractionTissueArea = 100*AreaBSTissue/(AreaBSTissue+AreaMTissue)) %>%
  mutate(RatioChloroPerCell = AreaChloro/AreaCell,
         RatioChloroPerCellM = AreaChloroM/AreaCellM,
         ChloroAreaTissue = RatioChloroPerCell*AreaBSTissue,
         ChloroAreaTissueM = RatioChloroPerCellM*AreaMTissue,
         BSFractionChloroArea = 100*ChloroAreaTissue/(ChloroAreaTissue+ChloroAreaTissueM)) %>%
  mutate(RatioMitoPerCell = AreaMito/AreaCell,
         RatioMitoPerCellM = AreaMitoM/AreaCellM,
         MitoAreaTissue = RatioMitoPerCell*AreaBSTissue,
         MitoAreaTissueM = RatioMitoPerCellM*AreaMTissue,
         BSFractionMitoArea = 100*MitoAreaTissue/(MitoAreaTissue+MitoAreaTissueM)) %>%
  mutate(DotsPerCellArea = (DotsPerMitoArea*AreaMito)/AreaCell,
         DotsPerCellAreaM = (DotsPerMitoAreaM*AreaMitoM)/AreaCellM,
         DotsTissue = DotsPerCellArea*AreaBSTissue,
         DotsTissueM = DotsPerCellAreaM*AreaMTissue,
         BSFractionGDC = 100*DotsTissue/(DotsTissue+DotsTissueM))
readr::write_csv(allocation_data, here::here("data/processed_data/allocation_data.csv"))

# Save a version for fitting C2 model
allocation_data_to_fit <- allocation_data %>%
  dplyr::select(Species, Plant, CO2, BSFractionGDC, BSFractionMitoArea, BSFractionChloroArea) %>%
  rename(f_GDC = BSFractionGDC,
         f_Rd = BSFractionMitoArea,
         f_rubisco = BSFractionChloroArea)
readr::write_csv(allocation_data_to_fit, here::here("data/processed_data/allocation_data_lmfit.csv"))

  
allocation_summary <- allocation_data %>%
  group_by(PhotosyntheticType, Species, CO2) %>%
  summarise(across(.cols = vars,
                   .fns = list(Mean = ~ mean(., na.rm = TRUE), 
                               SE = ~sd(., na.rm = TRUE)/sqrt(length(.)))))
readr::write_csv(allocation_summary, here::here("data/processed_data/allocation_data_summary.csv"))
```

## Anatomy Table

```{r table1}

anatomy_table <- allocation_summary %>%
  full_join(bs_tissue_frac_letters) %>%
  full_join(chloro_alloc_letters) %>%
  full_join(mito_alloc_letters) %>%
  full_join(chloro_mito_dist_letters) %>%
  full_join(gdc_alloc_letters) %>%
  full_join(gdc_dot_letters) %>%
  full_join(gdc_dot_m_letters) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(Species, CO2, contains(c("BSFractionChloroArea",
                                         "BSFractionMitoArea",
                                         "ChloroMitoEdgeDist",
                                         "BSFractionGDC",
                                         "DotsPerMitoArea",
                                         "DotsPerMitoAreaM"))) %>%
  mutate(Species = factor(Species, levels = SP_BREAKS),
         across(.cols = contains(c("BSFractionChloroArea_Mean", "BSFractionChloroArea_SE",
                                 "BSFractionMitoArea_Mean", "BSFractionMitoArea_SE",
                                 "BSFractionGDC_Mean", "BSFractionGDC_SE")),
                .fns = ~ sprintf("%.1f", plyr::round_any(.x, 0.1))),
         across(.cols = contains(c("ChloroMitoEdgeDist_Mean", "ChloroMitoEdgeDist_SE")),
                .fns = ~ sprintf("%.2f", plyr::round_any(.x, 0.01))),
         across(.cols = contains(c("DotsPerMitoArea_Mean", "DotsPerMitoArea_SE",
                                   "DotsPerMitoAreaM_Mean", "DotsPerMitoAreaM_SE")),
                .fns = ~ sprintf("%.0f", plyr::round_any(.x, 1)))) %>%
  mutate(BSFractionChloroArea = paste0(BSFractionChloroArea_Mean, " ± ", BSFractionChloroArea_SE, BSFractionChloroAreaLetter),
         BSFractionMitoArea = paste0(BSFractionMitoArea_Mean, " ± ", BSFractionMitoArea_SE, BSFractionMitoAreaLetter),
         ChloroMitoEdgeDist = paste0(ChloroMitoEdgeDist_Mean, " ± ", ChloroMitoEdgeDist_SE, ChloroMitoEdgeDistLetter),
         BSFractionGDC = paste0(BSFractionGDC_Mean, " ± ", BSFractionGDC_SE, BSFractionGDCLetter),
         DotsPerMitoArea = paste0(DotsPerMitoArea_Mean, " ± ", DotsPerMitoArea_SE, DotsPerMitoAreaLetter),
         DotsPerMitoAreaM = paste0(DotsPerMitoAreaM_Mean, " ± ", DotsPerMitoAreaM_SE, DotsPerMitoAreaMLetter),
         .keep = "unused") %>%
  dplyr::select(Species, CO2, c("BSFractionChloroArea", "BSFractionMitoArea",
                         "ChloroMitoEdgeDist", "BSFractionGDC", "DotsPerMitoAreaM")) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = "CO2",
                     values_from = c("BSFractionChloroArea", "BSFractionMitoArea",
                                     "ChloroMitoEdgeDist", "BSFractionGDC", "DotsPerMitoAreaM")) %>%
  arrange(Species)
writexl::write_xlsx(anatomy_table, here::here("tables/anatomy.xlsx"))
```

## Anatomy Photosynthetic Type table

```{r phototypetable}

# Join types first
allocation_phototype <- allocation_data %>%
  left_join(photosynthetic_types)

# Run Tests & Generate Letters

# Helper function to avoid repetition
get_letters <- function(data, var, alt_hypothesis) {
  data %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    filter(!is.na(PhotosyntheticType)) %>%
    group_by(PhotosyntheticType) %>%
    rstatix::t_test(as.formula(paste(var, "~ CO2")), 
                    alternative = alt_hypothesis, 
                    p.adjust.method = "none") %>%
    mutate(p = p.adjust(p, method = "fdr")) %>%
    mutate(Letter = case_when(p < 0.05 ~ "*", 
                              # p < 0.08 ~ "^",
                              .default = "")) %>%
    dplyr::select(PhotosyntheticType, Letter) %>%
    rename_with(~paste0(var, "Letter"), Letter)
}

# Run tests (Note: ChloroMitoEdgeDist is "less", others "greater")
dots_letters   <- get_letters(allocation_phototype, "DotsPerMitoArea", "greater")
gdc_letters    <- get_letters(allocation_phototype, "BSFractionGDC", "greater")
mito_letters   <- get_letters(allocation_phototype, "BSFractionMitoArea", "greater")
chloro_letters <- get_letters(allocation_phototype, "BSFractionChloroArea", "greater")
dist_letters   <- get_letters(allocation_phototype, "ChloroMitoEdgeDist", "less")

# Summarise Data

allocation_phototype_summary <- allocation_phototype %>%
  group_by(PhotosyntheticType, CO2) %>%
  summarise(across(.cols = c("BSFractionChloroArea", "BSFractionMitoArea", 
                             "ChloroMitoEdgeDist", "BSFractionGDC", "DotsPerMitoArea"),
                   .fns = list(Mean = ~mean(., na.rm = TRUE),
                               SE = ~sd(., na.rm = TRUE)/sqrt(n()))),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  full_join(dots_letters) %>%
  full_join(gdc_letters) %>%
  full_join(mito_letters) %>%
  full_join(chloro_letters) %>%
  full_join(dist_letters)

# Format and Stack Table (Traits as Rows)

anatomy_phototype_table <- allocation_phototype_summary %>%
  mutate(across(.cols = contains(c("BSFraction", "GDC")) & where(is.numeric), 
                .fns = ~ sprintf("%.1f", plyr::round_any(.x, 0.1))),
         
         across(.cols = contains("DotsPerMitoArea") & where(is.numeric), 
                .fns = ~ sprintf("%.0f", plyr::round_any(.x, 1))),
         
         across(.cols = contains("EdgeDist") & where(is.numeric), 
                .fns = ~ sprintf("%.2f", plyr::round_any(.x, 0.01)))) %>%
  # Paste Mean ± SE + Letter
  mutate(
    BSFractionChloroArea = paste0(BSFractionChloroArea_Mean, " ± ", BSFractionChloroArea_SE, BSFractionChloroAreaLetter),
    BSFractionMitoArea   = paste0(BSFractionMitoArea_Mean, " ± ", BSFractionMitoArea_SE, BSFractionMitoAreaLetter),
    BSFractionGDC        = paste0(BSFractionGDC_Mean, " ± ", BSFractionGDC_SE, BSFractionGDCLetter),
    DotsPerMitoArea      = paste0(DotsPerMitoArea_Mean, " ± ", DotsPerMitoArea_SE, DotsPerMitoAreaLetter),
    ChloroMitoEdgeDist   = paste0(ChloroMitoEdgeDist_Mean, " ± ", ChloroMitoEdgeDist_SE, ChloroMitoEdgeDistLetter)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(PhotosyntheticType, CO2, 
                BSFractionChloroArea, BSFractionMitoArea, BSFractionGDC, 
                DotsPerMitoArea, ChloroMitoEdgeDist) %>%
  # Pivot Longer to get Traits in Rows
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = c(BSFractionChloroArea, BSFractionMitoArea, BSFractionGDC, DotsPerMitoArea, ChloroMitoEdgeDist),
    names_to = "Trait",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  # Pivot Wider to get Type_CO2 columns
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = c(PhotosyntheticType, CO2),
    values_from = Value,
    names_glue = "{PhotosyntheticType}_{CO2}"
  ) %>%
  arrange(Trait)
```

## Does Γ in the objective tighten g~bs~ or change the CO2 contrasts? (look-see, writes nothing)

Standalone check for the CO2 study. Depends on the `setup` chunk only
(`library(dplyr)`, `here::i_am`); it re-reads the same inputs the Colab
notebook reads (`merged_gas_ex_lmfit_obs.csv`, `allocation_data_lmfit.csv`,
`cstars.csv`) plus `gammas.csv`, and re-defines the von Caemmerer C2 model in R.
Wrapped in `local()`, so it leaves no object in the workspace and writes no file.

Two objectives per leaf: the A--C~i~ points alone, and the same points plus the
leaf's own measured Γ (x-intercept of the 1500 PPFD Laisk line) as one extra
Gaussian observation with SD `GAMMA_SE`. With sigma profiled out of the A
residuals the joint objective is 0.5 n log(RSS/n) + 0.5 ((Γ~meas~ - Γ~model~)/`GAMMA_SE`)^2^.
The estimator here is maximum likelihood with a profile-likelihood interval on
g~bs~, not the MCMC posterior median of the notebook, so the A-only column will
not reproduce `fit_results_species_bayesian_FINAL.csv` exactly; where that file
exists its species means are printed beside the two objectives for reference.
Slow (two fits and two profiles per leaf, ~90 leaves); `eval = FALSE` so it does
not run on every knit.

```{r bs_fit_gamma_check, message=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
local({

# ---- knobs -------------------------------------------------------------------
GAMMA_SE  <- 2      # umol mol-1, SD of the measured Gamma used as its weight
N_PROFILE <- 80     # profile grid points on g_bs (fewer = faster)
CO2R_MAX  <- Inf    # notebook fits every point in the lmfit file; 420 restricts to the Rubisco-limited range
PUBLISHED <- here::here("fit_results_species_bayesian_FINAL.csv")   # MCMC medians, read only if present

# ---- constants (as the notebook) --------------------------------------------
K_UNIVERSAL <- list(Sco = 76 * (0.0334 / 0.00126), Kc = 14 / 0.0334,
                    Ko = 600 / 0.00126, gm = 0.6, alpha = 1, fRdh = 0.1, Om = 210000)
GBS_LO <- 1e-6; GBS_HI <- 0.2; VCMAX_LO <- 10; VCMAX_HI <- 400
# per-species Welch t tests on the same transforms and directions as model_fits (200 vs 800)
TESTS <- list(gbs = list(f = log,                   alt = "less"),
              gly = list(f = log,                   alt = "greater"),
              L   = list(f = function(x) log(x + 0.7), alt = "less"),
              Abs = list(f = log,                   alt = "greater"),
              Vcmax = list(f = identity,            alt = "two.sided"),
              Cbs = list(f = identity,              alt = "greater"))

make_k <- function(fGDC, fRd, frub, Rd)
  c(K_UNIVERSAL, list(fGDC = fGDC, fRd = fRd, frub = frub, Rd = Rd))

# ---- model -------------------------------------------------------------------
meso_terms <- function(Cm, Vcmax, k) {
  Vcm <- (1 - k$frub) * Vcmax * Cm / (Cm + k$Kc * (1 + k$Om / k$Ko))
  list(Vcm = Vcm, Vom = 2 * Vcm * (0.5 / k$Sco) * (k$Om / Cm))
}
bs_residual <- function(Cbs, Cm, Vcmax, gbs, k, mt) {
  Rdh  <- k$fRdh * k$Rd
  Rdbs <- k$fRd * (k$Rd - Rdh)
  L    <- gbs * (Cbs - Cm)
  Abs  <- 0.5 * k$fGDC * mt$Vom - L
  Obs  <- k$Om + k$alpha * Abs / (0.047 * gbs)
  Vcbs <- k$frub * Vcmax * Cbs / (Cbs + k$Kc * (1 + Obs / k$Ko))
  Vobs <- 2 * Vcbs * (0.5 / k$Sco) * (Obs / Cbs)
  L - (Rdbs + 0.5 * Vobs - Vcbs + 0.5 * k$fGDC * mt$Vom)
}
solve_Cbs <- function(Cm, Vcmax, gbs, k, mt) {
  lo <- 1e-6
  f_lo <- try(bs_residual(lo, Cm, Vcmax, gbs, k, mt), silent = TRUE)
  if (inherits(f_lo, "try-error") || !is.finite(f_lo)) return(NA_real_)
  hi <- max(2 * Cm, 1000); f_hi <- NA_real_
  for (i in seq_len(60)) {
    f_hi <- try(bs_residual(hi, Cm, Vcmax, gbs, k, mt), silent = TRUE)
    if (inherits(f_hi, "try-error")) return(NA_real_)
    if (is.finite(f_hi) && f_lo * f_hi < 0) break
    hi <- hi * 1.6
  }
  if (!is.finite(f_hi) || f_lo * f_hi > 0) return(NA_real_)
  out <- try(uniroot(bs_residual, interval = c(lo, hi), Cm = Cm, Vcmax = Vcmax,
                     gbs = gbs, k = k, mt = mt, tol = 1e-9)$root, silent = TRUE)
  if (inherits(out, "try-error")) NA_real_ else out
}
c2_state <- function(Cm, Vcmax, gbs, k) {
  mt  <- meso_terms(Cm, Vcmax, k)
  Cbs <- solve_Cbs(Cm, Vcmax, gbs, k, mt)
  if (!is.finite(Cbs))
    return(list(A = NA_real_, Cbs = NA_real_, L = NA_real_, Abs = NA_real_, gly = NA_real_))
  Rdh  <- k$fRdh * k$Rd
  Rdm  <- (1 - k$fRd) * (k$Rd - Rdh)
  Rdbs <- k$fRd * (k$Rd - Rdh)
  L    <- gbs * (Cbs - Cm)
  Abs  <- 0.5 * k$fGDC * mt$Vom - L
  Obs  <- k$Om + k$alpha * Abs / (0.047 * gbs)
  Vcbs <- k$frub * Vcmax * Cbs / (Cbs + k$Kc * (1 + Obs / k$Ko))
  Vobs <- 2 * Vcbs * (0.5 / k$Sco) * (Obs / Cbs)
  list(A = (Vcbs + mt$Vcm) - 0.5 * (mt$Vom + Vobs) - Rdm - Rdbs,
       Cbs = Cbs, L = L, Abs = Abs, gly = 0.5 * k$fGDC * mt$Vom)
}
c2_A <- function(Cm, Vcmax, gbs, k)
  vapply(Cm, function(x) c2_state(x, Vcmax, gbs, k)$A, numeric(1))
# CO2 compensation point in Cm; at A = 0, Cm = Ci, so comparable with measured Gamma
model_gamma <- function(Vcmax, gbs, k, lo = 1, hi = 400) {
  f <- function(x) c2_A(x, Vcmax, gbs, k)
  a <- f(lo); b <- f(hi)
  if (!is.finite(a) || !is.finite(b) || a * b > 0) return(NA_real_)
  uniroot(f, c(lo, hi), tol = 1e-6)$root
}

# ---- objective: A/Ci alone (Gobs = NA), or A/Ci + Gamma ---------------------
nll_joint <- function(logpar, Cm, Aobs, k, Gobs = NA_real_, Gse = GAMMA_SE) {
  V <- exp(logpar[1]); g <- exp(logpar[2])
  if (V < VCMAX_LO || V > VCMAX_HI || g < GBS_LO || g > GBS_HI) return(1e10)
  pred <- c2_A(Cm, V, g, k)
  if (any(!is.finite(pred))) return(1e10)
  rss <- sum((Aobs - pred)^2)
  if (!is.finite(rss) || rss <= 0) return(1e10)
  out <- 0.5 * length(Aobs) * log(rss / length(Aobs))
  if (is.finite(Gobs)) {
    Gm <- model_gamma(V, g, k)
    if (!is.finite(Gm)) return(1e10)
    out <- out + 0.5 * ((Gobs - Gm) / Gse)^2
  }
  out
}
fit_one <- function(Cm, Aobs, k, Gobs = NA_real_, V0 = 80) {
  best <- NULL
  for (gs in c(1e-4, 1e-3, 1e-2, 1e-1)) {
    o <- try(optim(c(log(V0), log(gs)), nll_joint, Cm = Cm, Aobs = Aobs, k = k,
                   Gobs = Gobs, method = "Nelder-Mead",
                   control = list(reltol = 1e-12, maxit = 3000)), silent = TRUE)
    if (inherits(o, "try-error")) next
    if (is.null(best) || o$value < best$value) best <- o
  }
  if (is.null(best) || best$value >= 1e9) return(NULL)
  list(Vcmax = exp(best$par[1]), gbs = exp(best$par[2]), nll = best$value)
}
profile_one <- function(Cm, Aobs, k, fit, Gobs = NA_real_, n_grid = N_PROFILE, level = 0.95) {
  grid <- exp(seq(log(GBS_LO), log(GBS_HI), length.out = n_grid))
  dev <- vapply(grid, function(g) {
    o <- try(optimize(function(lv) nll_joint(c(lv, log(g)), Cm, Aobs, k, Gobs),
                      interval = log(c(VCMAX_LO, VCMAX_HI)), tol = 1e-8), silent = TRUE)
    if (inherits(o, "try-error")) NA_real_ else o$objective
  }, numeric(1))
  d  <- 2 * (dev - fit$nll)
  ok <- is.finite(d) & d <= qchisq(level, df = 1)
  if (!any(ok)) return(list(lo = NA_real_, hi = NA_real_, flat = NA))
  lo <- min(grid[ok]); hi <- max(grid[ok])
  list(lo = lo, hi = hi, flat = (lo <= grid[2]) && (hi >= grid[n_grid - 1]))
}

# ---- inputs (as the notebook) ------------------------------------------------
# A/Ci: PARi 1500 curves, one row per (Species, Plant, CO2, rounded CO2R)
aci <- readr::read_csv(here::here("data/gas_ex/merged_gas_ex_lmfit_obs.csv"),
                       show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  rename(CO2 = GrowthCO2ppm) %>%
  filter(is.finite(Photo), is.finite(Ci)) %>%
  mutate(CO2R_r = round(CO2R, -1)) %>%
  group_by(Species, Plant, CO2, CO2R_r) %>%
  summarise(Photo = mean(Photo), Ci = mean(Ci), CO2R = mean(CO2R), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(Species, Plant, CO2, CO2R)
aci_fit <- aci %>% filter(CO2R <= CO2R_MAX)

# fixed inputs: species x CO2 means (percent -> fraction; Rd stored as the
# negative Laisk intercept, flipped to a positive rate)
alloc_mean <- readr::read_csv(here::here("data/processed_data/allocation_data_lmfit.csv"),
                              show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  group_by(Species, CO2) %>%
  summarise(fGDC = mean(f_GDC, na.rm = TRUE) / 100, fRd = mean(f_Rd, na.rm = TRUE) / 100,
            frub = mean(f_rubisco, na.rm = TRUE) / 100, .groups = "drop")
cst <- readr::read_csv(here::here("data/processed_data/cstars.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  rename(CO2 = GrowthCO2ppm)
if (median(cst$Rd, na.rm = TRUE) < 0) cst$Rd <- -cst$Rd
rd_mean <- cst %>% group_by(Species, CO2) %>%
  summarise(Rd = mean(Rd, na.rm = TRUE), Cstar = mean(Cstar, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
gam <- readr::read_csv(here::here("data/processed_data/gammas.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%

gam_mean <- gam %>% group_by(Species, CO2) %>%

            Gamma_sd = sd(Gamma_plant, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
inputs_mean <- alloc_mean %>%
  inner_join(rd_mean, by = c("Species", "CO2")) %>%
  left_join(gam_mean, by = c("Species", "CO2"))

cat("GAMMA_SE used as the Gamma weight:", GAMMA_SE, "umol mol-1\n")
cat("within species x CO2 SD of plant-level Gamma (upper bound on the measurement SD):\n")
print(inputs_mean %>% select(Species, CO2, Gamma_mean, Gamma_sd, Rd, fGDC, frub) %>%
        mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ signif(.x, 3))), n = Inf)

# ---- fit every leaf under both objectives ------------------------------------
groups <- aci_fit %>% distinct(Species, Plant, CO2)
rows <- vector("list", nrow(groups))
t0 <- Sys.time()
for (i in seq_len(nrow(groups))) {
  gr <- groups[i, ]
  d  <- aci_fit %>% semi_join(gr, by = c("Species", "Plant", "CO2")) %>% arrange(CO2R)
  ip <- inputs_mean %>% semi_join(gr, by = c("Species", "CO2"))
  gp <- gam %>% semi_join(gr, by = c("Species", "Plant", "CO2"))
  if (nrow(d) < 3 || nrow(ip) != 1) next
  Gobs <- if (nrow(gp) == 1 && is.finite(gp$Gamma_plant)) gp$Gamma_plant else ip$Gamma_mean
  k  <- make_k(ip$fGDC, ip$fRd, ip$frub, ip$Rd)
  Cm <- d$Ci - d$Photo / K_UNIVERSAL$gm
  A  <- d$Photo
  # reporting point: the lowest Ca step at or above 380 (as the notebook), else the closest to 400
  full <- aci %>% semi_join(gr, by = c("Species", "Plant", "CO2")) %>% arrange(CO2R)
  j <- which(round(full$CO2R, -1) >= 380)
  j <- if (length(j)) j[1] else which.min(abs(full$CO2R - 400))
  Cm_ref <- full$Ci[j] - full$Photo[j] / K_UNIVERSAL$gm

  one <- function(obj, Gval) {
    fit <- fit_one(Cm, A, k, Gval)
    if (is.null(fit)) return(NULL)
    pr <- profile_one(Cm, A, k, fit, Gval)
    st <- c2_state(Cm_ref, fit$Vcmax, fit$gbs, k)
    tibble(objective = obj, Vcmax = fit$Vcmax, gbs = fit$gbs,
           gbs_lo = pr$lo, gbs_hi = pr$hi, flat = isTRUE(pr$flat),
           Cbs = st$Cbs, L = st$L, Abs = st$Abs, gly = st$gly,
           model_Gamma = model_gamma(fit$Vcmax, fit$gbs, k))
  }
  rows[[i]] <- bind_rows(one("A_only", NA_real_), one("A_plus_Gamma", Gobs)) %>%
    mutate(Species = gr$Species, Plant = gr$Plant, CO2 = gr$CO2,
           n_points = length(A), meas_Gamma = Gobs, .before = 1)
}
res <- bind_rows(rows) %>%
  mutate(width_log10 = log10(gbs_hi / gbs_lo),
         se_log_gbs  = (log(gbs_hi) - log(gbs_lo)) / (2 * qnorm(0.975)),
         at_upper    = gbs >= GBS_HI * 0.999,
         at_lower    = gbs <= GBS_LO * 1.001)
cat("\nfitted", nrow(groups), "leaves x 2 objectives in",
    round(as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "mins")), 1), "min\n")

# ---- per-leaf comparison (g_bs in mmol m-2 s-1 bar-1, as the manuscript) -----
cat("\nPer leaf: g_bs (mmol), 95% profile interval and its width, both objectives\n")
res %>%
  transmute(Species, Plant, CO2, objective, n_points, Vcmax,
            gbs = 1000 * gbs, gbs_lo = 1000 * gbs_lo, gbs_hi = 1000 * gbs_hi,
            width_log10, se_log_gbs, flat, at_lower, at_upper, model_Gamma, meas_Gamma) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ signif(.x, 3))) %>%
  arrange(Species, CO2, Plant, objective) %>%
  print(n = Inf, width = Inf)

cat("\nInterval width and identification, by objective\n")
res %>%
  group_by(objective) %>%
  summarise(n = n(),
            mean_width_log10 = mean(width_log10, na.rm = TRUE),
            median_width_log10 = median(width_log10, na.rm = TRUE),
            mean_se_log_gbs = mean(se_log_gbs, na.rm = TRUE),
            n_flat = sum(flat), n_at_lower = sum(at_lower), n_at_upper = sum(at_upper),
            mean_abs_Gamma_error = mean(abs(model_Gamma - meas_Gamma), na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ signif(.x, 3))) %>%
  print(width = Inf)

cat("\nRatio of interval widths per leaf (A + Gamma over A only), by species; < 1 means Gamma tightened it\n")
res %>%
  select(Species, Plant, CO2, objective, width_log10) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = objective, values_from = width_log10) %>%
  mutate(ratio = A_plus_Gamma / A_only) %>%
  group_by(Species) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), median_ratio = median(ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
            min_ratio = min(ratio, na.rm = TRUE), max_ratio = max(ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ signif(.x, 3))) %>%
  print(n = Inf)

# ---- per-species 200 vs 800 tests, both objectives (as model_fits) -----------
welch <- function(x200, x800, alt) {
  if (sum(is.finite(x200)) < 2 || sum(is.finite(x800)) < 2) return(NA_real_)
  t.test(x200[is.finite(x200)], x800[is.finite(x800)], alternative = alt, var.equal = FALSE)$p.value
}
long <- res %>%
  select(objective, Species, Plant, CO2, gbs, gly, L, Abs, Vcmax, Cbs) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(c(gbs, gly, L, Abs, Vcmax, Cbs), names_to = "trait", values_to = "val")
tests <- long %>%
  group_by(objective, Species, trait) %>%
  summarise(n200 = sum(CO2 == 200 & is.finite(val)), n800 = sum(CO2 == 800 & is.finite(val)),
            mean200 = mean(val[CO2 == 200], na.rm = TRUE),
            mean800 = mean(val[CO2 == 800], na.rm = TRUE),
            p = {
              tr <- TESTS[[dplyr::first(trait)]]
              v  <- suppressWarnings(tr$f(val))
              signif(welch(v[CO2 == 200], v[CO2 == 800], tr$alt), 3)
            },
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(alt = vapply(trait, function(t) TESTS[[t]]$alt, character(1)),
         sig = case_when(is.na(p) ~ "", p < 0.05 ~ "*", p < 0.08 ~ "^", TRUE ~ ""))

cat("\nPer-species Welch t tests, 200 vs 800 ppm, p side by side (* p < 0.05, ^ p < 0.08)\n")
tests %>%
  select(trait, Species, alt, objective, p, sig) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = objective, values_from = c(p, sig)) %>%
  arrange(trait, Species) %>%
  print(n = Inf, width = Inf)

cat("\nSpecies x CO2 means, both objectives (g_bs in mmol)\n")
means <- res %>%
  group_by(objective, Species, CO2) %>%
  summarise(n = n(),
            gbs_se = 1000 * sd(gbs, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(is.finite(gbs))),
            gbs = 1000 * mean(gbs, na.rm = TRUE),
            Vcmax = mean(Vcmax, na.rm = TRUE), gly = mean(gly, na.rm = TRUE),
            L = mean(L, na.rm = TRUE), Cbs = mean(Cbs, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
if (file.exists(PUBLISHED)) {
  pub <- readr::read_csv(PUBLISHED, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    group_by(Species, CO2 = CO2_Growth) %>%
    summarise(gbs_published_mcmc = 1000 * mean(g_bs_Value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  means <- means %>% left_join(pub, by = c("Species", "CO2"))
}
means %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ signif(.x, 3))) %>%
  arrange(Species, CO2, objective) %>%
  print(n = Inf, width = Inf)

invisible(NULL)
})
```

``` {r model_fits}
### PHOTOTYPE

# Join types first
model_fits_phototype <- model_fits %>%
  left_join(photosynthetic_types)

# Run Tests & Generate Letters

# Helper function to handle the specific log transformations and alternatives you used
get_model_letters <- function(data, var_name, transform_expr, alt_hyp) {
  data %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    filter(!is.na(PhotosyntheticType)) %>%
    mutate(transformed_var = !!rlang::parse_expr(transform_expr)) %>%
    group_by(PhotosyntheticType) %>%
    rstatix::t_test(transformed_var ~ CO2, alternative = alt_hyp, p.adjust.method = "none") %>%
    mutate(Letter = case_when(p < 0.05 ~ "*", 
                              # p < 0.08 ~ "^",
                              .default = "")) %>%
    mutate(p = p.adjust(p, method = "fdr")) %>%
    dplyr::select(PhotosyntheticType, Letter) %>%
    rename_with(~paste0(var_name, "Letter"), Letter)
}

# Run tests matching your specific logic:
# g_bs: log, less
gbs_letters <- get_model_letters(model_fits_phototype, "g_bs", "log(g_bs)", "less")

# Gly_Shuttle_Rate: log, greater
gly_letters <- get_model_letters(model_fits_phototype, "Gly_Shuttle_Rate", "log(Gly_Shuttle_Rate)", "greater")

# L (Leakage): log(L + 0.7), less
leakage_letters <- get_model_letters(model_fits_phototype, "L", "log(L + 0.7)", "less")

# Abs_at_Ambient_Cm: log, greater
abs_letters <- get_model_letters(model_fits_phototype, "Abs_at_Ambient_Cm", "log(Abs_at_Ambient_Cm)", "greater")

# C_bs: no log, greater
cbs_letters <- get_model_letters(model_fits_phototype, "C_bs", "C_bs", "greater")

# V_cmax: no log, two-sided (default)
vcmax_letters <- model_fits_phototype %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(!is.na(PhotosyntheticType)) %>%
  group_by(PhotosyntheticType) %>%
  rstatix::t_test(V_cmax ~ CO2, p.adjust.method = "none") %>%
  mutate(V_cmaxLetter = case_when(p < 0.05 ~ "*", 
                                  p < 0.08 ~ "^",
                                  .default = "")) %>%
  dplyr::select(PhotosyntheticType, V_cmaxLetter)

# Summarise Data

model_fits_phototype_summary <- model_fits_phototype %>%
  group_by(PhotosyntheticType, CO2) %>%
  summarise(across(.cols = all_of(model_vars),
                   .fns = list(Mean = ~ mean(., na.rm = TRUE), 
                               SE = ~sd(., na.rm = TRUE)/sqrt(length(.)))),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  full_join(gbs_letters) %>%
  full_join(gly_letters) %>%
  full_join(leakage_letters) %>%
  full_join(abs_letters) %>%
  full_join(cbs_letters) %>%
  full_join(vcmax_letters)

# Format and Stack Table (Traits as Rows)

model_fits_phototype_table <- model_fits_phototype_summary %>%
  # Rounding logic: V_cmax & g_bs & C_bs (integer), others (2 decimals)
  mutate(across(.cols = contains(c("V_cmax", "g_bs", "C_bs")) & where(is.numeric), 
                .fns = ~ sprintf("%.0f", plyr::round_any(.x, 1))),
         
         across(.cols = contains(c("Gly_Shuttle_Rate", "Abs_at_Ambient_Cm", "L")) & where(is.numeric), 
                .fns = ~ sprintf("%.2f", plyr::round_any(.x, 0.01)))) %>%
  
  # Paste Mean ± SE + Letter
  mutate(
    V_cmax           = paste0(V_cmax_Mean, " ± ", V_cmax_SE, V_cmaxLetter),
    g_bs             = paste0(g_bs_Mean, " ± ", g_bs_SE, g_bsLetter),
    Gly_Shuttle_Rate = paste0(Gly_Shuttle_Rate_Mean, " ± ", Gly_Shuttle_Rate_SE, Gly_Shuttle_RateLetter),
    Abs              = paste0(Abs_at_Ambient_Cm_Mean, " ± ", Abs_at_Ambient_Cm_SE, Abs_at_Ambient_CmLetter),
    L                = paste0(L_Mean, " ± ", L_SE, LLetter),
    C_bs             = paste0(C_bs_Mean, " ± ", C_bs_SE, C_bsLetter)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(PhotosyntheticType, CO2, V_cmax, g_bs, Gly_Shuttle_Rate, Abs, L, C_bs) %>%
  
  # Pivot Longer to get Traits in Rows
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = c(V_cmax, g_bs, Gly_Shuttle_Rate, Abs, L, C_bs),
    names_to = "Trait",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  
  # Pivot Wider to get Type_CO2 columns
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = c(PhotosyntheticType, CO2),
    values_from = Value,
    names_glue = "{PhotosyntheticType}_{CO2}"
  ) %>%
  arrange(Trait)

writexl::write_xlsx(model_fits_phototype_table, here::here("tables/phototype_model_fits.xlsx"))
```

``` {r aci_model}
# --- Load data if not already in environment ---

  mutate(GrowthCO2ppm = as.factor(GrowthCO2ppm))

  mutate(GrowthCO2ppm = as.factor(CO2_Growth))

gm_VALUE <- 0.6

raw_summary <- raw_gas_ex %>%
  mutate(Ci_Bin = Obs) %>%
  group_by(Species, GrowthCO2ppm, Ci_Bin) %>%
  summarise(
    Photo_Mean = mean(Photo, na.rm = TRUE),
    Photo_SE   = sd(Photo, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    Ci_Mean    = mean(Ci, na.rm = TRUE),
    Ci_SE      = sd(Ci, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

model_summary <- model_fits_curves %>%
  group_by(Species, GrowthCO2ppm, Cm_Model) %>%
  summarise(
    A_Mean  = median(A_Modeled, na.rm = TRUE),
    A_SE    = sd(A_Modeled, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(Species = factor(Species, levels = SP_BREAKS)) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(Ci_Mean = Cm_Model + A_Mean / gm_VALUE)

# --- Main text species and supplementary species ---

# --- Shared plot function ---
plot_aci_model <- function(raw_data, model_data, ncol_facet = 3) {
  ggplot() +
    geom_line(data = model_data,
              aes(x = Ci_Mean, y = A_Mean, linetype = GrowthCO2ppm, group = GrowthCO2ppm),
              linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_errorbarh(data = raw_data,
                   aes(y = Photo_Mean, xmin = Ci_Mean - Ci_SE, xmax = Ci_Mean + Ci_SE),
                   height = 0, linewidth = 0.25, color = "grey30") +
    geom_errorbar(data = raw_data,
                  aes(x = Ci_Mean, ymin = Photo_Mean - Photo_SE, ymax = Photo_Mean + Photo_SE),
                  width = 0, linewidth = 0.25) +
    geom_point(data = raw_data,
               aes(x = Ci_Mean, y = Photo_Mean, fill = GrowthCO2ppm, shape = GrowthCO2ppm),
               size = 2) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("black", "white")) +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = c("solid", "dotted")) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c(21, 22)) +
    scale_x_continuous(name = expression(Intercellular~CO[2]~concentration~"("*µmol~mol^-1*")"),
                       limits = c(0, 300), breaks = seq(0, 1500, 100), expand = expansion()) +
    scale_y_continuous(name = expression(Net~CO[2]~assimilation~rate~"("*µmol~m^-2~s^-1*")"),
                       limits = c(-2, 35), breaks = seq(0, 60, 5), expand = expansion()) +
    labs(fill = expression(italic(C)[growth]~"(" * µmol ~ mol^-1 * ")"),
         shape = expression(italic(C)[growth]~"(" * µmol ~ mol^-1 * ")"),
         linetype = expression(italic(C)[growth]~"(" * µmol ~ mol^-1 * ")")) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    theme(legend.position = "top",
          legend.justification = "center",
          strip.text = element_text(face = "italic"),
          plot.margin = margin(5.5, 12, 5.5, 5.5)) +
    ggh4x::facet_wrap2(~Species, axes = "all", ncol = ncol_facet)
}
```

```{r aci_model_example}
rmse_by_plant <- obs_sp %>%
  group_by(Plant, GrowthCO2ppm) %>%
  group_modify(~{
    cc <- curve_sp %>%
      filter(Plant == .y$Plant, GrowthCO2ppm == .y$GrowthCO2ppm) %>%
      distinct(Ci_Model, .keep_all = TRUE) %>% arrange(Ci_Model)
    if (nrow(cc) < 2) return(tibble(rmse = NA_real_, n_pts = 0L))
    pred <- approx(cc$Ci_Model, cc$A_Model, xout = .x$Ci, rule = 1)$y
    ok <- is.finite(pred)
    tibble(rmse = sqrt(mean((.x$Photo[ok] - pred[ok])^2)), n_pts = sum(ok))
  }) %>% ungroup() %>% arrange(GrowthCO2ppm, rmse)
```

## PCA x model fits

```{r }

# --- 1. Helper Functions ---
get_stars <- function(p) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    p < 0.001 ~ "***",
    p < 0.01  ~ "**",
    p < 0.05  ~ "*",
    p < 0.1   ~ ".",
    TRUE      ~ "ns"
  )
}

get_stats_data <- function(data, outcome, predictor) {
  f <- as.formula(paste(outcome, "~", predictor, "* CO2"))
  mod <- nlme::lme(f, random = ~ 1 | Species, data = data, na.action = na.omit)
  res <- stats::anova(mod)
  
  # Row Labels
  lab1 <- paste0(predictor, "~'", get_stars(res[2, "p-value"]), "'")
  lab2 <- paste0("italic(C)[growth]~'", get_stars(res[3, "p-value"]), "'")
  lab3 <- paste0(predictor, ":italic(C)[growth]~'", get_stars(res[4, "p-value"]), "'")
  
  # Return tibble with line numbers (0, 1, 2 for easy math)
  tibble::tibble(
    label = c(lab1, lab2, lab3),
    line_idx = c(0, 1, 2) 
  )
}
get_stats_data_plme <- function(data, outcome, predictor, phylo) {
  
  # Validate inputs
  if (is.null(phylo)) {
    stop("A phylogenetic tree must be provided for PLME")
  }
  
  if (!"Species" %in% names(data)) {
    stop("Data must have a 'Species' column for PLME")
  }
  
  # Create formula
  f <- as.formula(paste(outcome, "~", predictor, "* CO2"))
  
  # Prepare data: remove NAs
  data_clean <- data[complete.cases(data[, c(outcome, predictor, "CO2", "Species")]), ]
  
  # Prune tree to match data
  tree_pruned <- ape::keep.tip(phylo, data_clean$Species)
  
  
  # B. Model Selection: Test BM, OU, and Lambda WITH random effects ----------
  # 1. Brownian Motion PLME
  bm_corr <- ape::corBrownian(phy = tree_pruned, form = ~Species)
  fit_bm <- nlme::lme(
    fixed = f, 
    random = ~ 1 | Species,
    correlation = bm_corr,
    data = data_clean,
    method = "ML"
  )
  aic_bm <- AIC(fit_bm)
  
  # 2. Ornstein-Uhlenbeck PLME (with error handling)
  fit_ou <- NULL
  aic_ou <- NA
  tryCatch({
    ou_corr <- ape::corMartins(value = 0.1, phy = tree_pruned, form = ~Species, fixed = FALSE)
    fit_ou <- nlme::lme(
      fixed = f,
      random = ~ 1 | Species,
      correlation = ou_corr,
      data = data_clean,
      method = "ML"
    )
    aic_ou <- AIC(fit_ou)
  }, error = function(e) {
    message(paste("  OU model failed - using BM and Lambda only"))
  })
  
  # 3. Pagel's Lambda PLME
  fit_lambda <- NULL
  aic_lambda <- NA
  tryCatch({
    lambda_corr <- ape::corPagel(value = 0.5, phy = tree_pruned, form = ~Species, fixed = FALSE)
    fit_lambda <- nlme::lme(
      fixed = f,
      random = ~ 1 | Species,
      correlation = lambda_corr,
      data = data_clean,
      method = "ML"
    )
    aic_lambda <- AIC(fit_lambda)
  }, error = function(e) {
    message(paste("  Lambda model failed"))
  })
  
  # 4. Compare AICs and select best model (only from successful fits)
  aic_values <- c(BM = aic_bm, OU = aic_ou, Lambda = aic_lambda)
  aic_values <- aic_values[!is.na(aic_values)]
  
  best_model_name <- names(which.min(aic_values))
  
  # Select the best fitting model
  fit <- switch(best_model_name,
                "BM" = fit_bm,
                "OU" = fit_ou,
                "Lambda" = fit_lambda)
  
  # Extract model parameters for reporting
  model_params <- switch(best_model_name,
                        "BM" = "Brownian Motion",
                        "OU" = paste0("Ornstein-Uhlenbeck (alpha = ", 
                                     round(coef(fit$modelStruct$corStruct, unconstrained = FALSE), 3), ")"),
                        "Lambda" = paste0("Pagel's Lambda (λ = ", 
                                         round(coef(fit$modelStruct$corStruct, unconstrained = FALSE), 3), ")"))
  
  # Get ANOVA results from best model
  res <- stats::anova(fit)
  
  # Row Labels
  lab1 <- paste0(predictor, "~'", get_stars(res[2, "p-value"]), "'")
  lab2 <- paste0("italic(C)[growth]~'", get_stars(res[3, "p-value"]), "'")
  lab3 <- paste0(predictor, ":italic(C)[growth]~'", get_stars(res[4, "p-value"]), "'")
  
  # Return tibble with line numbers and model info
  tibble::tibble(
    label = c(lab1, lab2, lab3),
    line_idx = c(0, 1, 2),
    model = rep(paste0("PLME_", best_model_name), 3),
    model_details = rep(model_params, 3),
    AIC_BM = rep(round(aic_bm, 2), 3),
    AIC_OU = rep(ifelse(is.na(aic_ou), NA, round(aic_ou, 2)), 3),
    AIC_Lambda = rep(ifelse(is.na(aic_lambda), NA, round(aic_lambda, 2)), 3)
  )
}

                    ymax = Abs_at_Ambient_Cm_Mean+Abs_at_Ambient_Cm_SE), width = 0, linewidth = 0.25) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = CO2, shape = CO2), size = 1.5) +
  
  geom_text(data = stats_pc2_abs, 
            aes(x = min_pc2, y = max_abs - (line_idx * step_abs), label = label),
            parse = TRUE, hjust = 0, size = 3.5, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
            
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 8), breaks = seq(0, 8, 2), expand = expansion(0, 0)) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-3, 3), breaks = seq(-4, 4, 1), expand = expansion(0, 0)) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(21, 22)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("black", "white")) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("solid", "dotted")) +
  labs(x = "Structural PC2",
       y = expression(italic(A[s])~"("*µmol~m^-2~s^-1*")")) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# Plot C: Gly vs PC1
p_c <- pca_model_fits %>% stats::na.omit() %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = PC1, y = Gly_Shuttle_Rate_Mean)) +
  moderndive::geom_parallel_slopes(aes(linetype = CO2), color = "black", linewidth = 0.5, se = FALSE) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Gly_Shuttle_Rate_Mean-Gly_Shuttle_Rate_SE,
                    ymax = Gly_Shuttle_Rate_Mean+Gly_Shuttle_Rate_SE), width = 0, linewidth = 0.25) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = CO2, shape = CO2), size = 1.5) +
  
  geom_text(data = stats_pc1_gly, 
            aes(x = min_pc1, y = max_gly - (line_idx * step_gly), label = label),
            parse = TRUE, hjust = 0, size = 3.5, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
           
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-5, 4), breaks = seq(-6, 4, 2), expand = expansion(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 10), breaks = seq(0, 10, 2), expand = expansion(0, 0)) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(21, 22)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("black", "white")) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("solid", "dotted")) +
  labs(x = "Structural PC1",
       y = expression(Gly~shuttle~rate~"("*µmol~m^-2~s^-1*")")) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# Plot D: Gly vs PC2
p_d <- pca_model_fits %>% stats::na.omit() %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = PC2, y = Gly_Shuttle_Rate_Mean)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "black", linewidth = 0.5, se = FALSE) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Gly_Shuttle_Rate_Mean-Gly_Shuttle_Rate_SE,
                    ymax = Gly_Shuttle_Rate_Mean+Gly_Shuttle_Rate_SE), width = 0, linewidth = 0.25) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = CO2, shape = CO2), size = 1.5) +
  
  geom_text(data = stats_pc2_gly, 
            aes(x = min_pc2, y = max_gly - (line_idx * step_gly), label = label),
            parse = TRUE, hjust = 0, size = 3.5, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 10), breaks = seq(0, 10, 2), expand = expansion(0, 0)) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-3, 3), breaks = seq(-4, 4, 1), expand = expansion(0, 0)) +          
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(21, 22)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("black", "white")) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("solid", "dotted")) +
  labs(x = "Structural PC2",
       y = expression(Gly~shuttle~rate~"("*µmol~m^-2~s^-1*")")) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# --- 5. Assembly ---
final_pca_grid <- cowplot::plot_grid(
  p_a, p_b, p_c, p_d,
  align = "hv",
  hjust = -3.5, vjust = 2
)

ggsave(here::here("figures/pca", "PCA_model_plot_stats_final.tif"),
       final_pca_grid,
       height = 6.5, width = 6.5, bg = "white", dpi = 500)
```

## PGLS - fGDC C*

```{r pgls_gdc_cstar}
# fGDC vs C*: PGLS on species x CO2 means (primary) and LME on plant values (supporting).
# AIC selects linear vs quadratic within each framework; BM excluded when AIC is non-finite.
# Solid line = AIC-selected PGLS fit; dashed = reference from Leung et al. (2024).

library(ape)
library(nlme)
library(ggtext)

# --- 1. Species x CO2 means (PGLS data) ----------------------------
cstars_mean <- readr::read_csv(here::here("data/processed_data/cstars.csv")) %>%
  full_join(readr::read_csv(here::here("data/processed_data/gammas.csv"))) %>%
  mutate(CO2 = as.factor(GrowthCO2ppm)) %>%
  group_by(Species, CO2) %>%
  summarise(across(.cols = c("Cstar", "Gamma"),
                   .fns = list(Mean = ~ mean(., na.rm = TRUE),
                               SE = ~ sd(., na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(length(.))))) %>%
  ungroup()

allocation_summary <- readr::read_csv(here::here("data/processed_data/allocation_data_summary.csv")) %>%
  dplyr::select(Species, CO2, contains("BSFractionGDC")) %>%
  mutate(CO2 = as.factor(CO2))

species_numbers <- tibble(Species = SP_BREAKS,
                          sp_label = as.character(seq_along(SP_BREAKS)))

cstar_gdc <- full_join(cstars_mean, allocation_summary, by = c("Species", "CO2")) %>%
  left_join(species_numbers, by = "Species") %>%
  filter(complete.cases(Species, BSFractionGDC_Mean, Cstar_Mean, CO2))

# --- 2. Phylogeny (same tree and tip cleaning as the Asp-AT PGLS) ---
tree <- ape::read.tree(here::here("data/co2_species_tree.tre"))
tree$tip.label <- tree$tip.label %>%
  stringr::str_replace("_", " ") %>%
  sapply(function(x) paste(stringr::str_sub(x, 1, 1), stringr::word(x, 2), sep = ". "))
tree$node.label <- NULL
tree_pruned <- ape::keep.tip(tree, unique(cstar_gdc$Species))

# --- 3. Fully factorial model selection: {linear, quadratic} x {no CO2, CO2 interaction} ---
# PRIMARY  = non-phylogenetic OLS (reported, and drives the plotted line).
# SECONDARY = PGLS robustness (Brownian drops out via non-finite AIC).
# Simplest model = fewest parameters within dAIC <= 2 of the best.
rhs_set <- c(
  lin_noint  = "BSFractionGDC_Mean",
  quad_noint = "BSFractionGDC_Mean + I(BSFractionGDC_Mean^2)",
  lin_int    = "BSFractionGDC_Mean * CO2",
  quad_int   = "(BSFractionGDC_Mean + I(BSFractionGDC_Mean^2)) * CO2")

# --- PRIMARY: non-phylogenetic OLS on species x CO2 means ---
lm_fits <- lapply(rhs_set, function(r)
  lm(as.formula(paste("Cstar_Mean ~", r)), data = cstar_gdc))
lm_sum <- summarise_fit_set(lm_fits)
cat("\n=== Fig. 6 PRIMARY (non-phylogenetic OLS): Ci* ~ fGLDP, fully factorial ===\n")
print(as.data.frame(lm_sum$table), row.names = FALSE)

primary_name <- lm_sum$best_name
primary_fit  <- lm_fits[[primary_name]]
primary_rhs  <- rhs_set[[primary_name]]
primary_has_co2 <- grepl("CO2", primary_rhs)
cat(sprintf("\nSelected simplest primary model (fewest params within dAIC<=2): %s\n", primary_name))
cat("Primary coefficient table (Estimate, SE, t, p):\n")
print(as.data.frame(tidy_fit(primary_fit)), row.names = FALSE)
cat(sprintf("Primary R2 = %.3f | adjusted R2 = %.3f\n",
            summary(primary_fit)$r.squared, summary(primary_fit)$adj.r.squared))
# Model-level F test. With x and x^2 collinear, the individual coefficient p-values
# are not the quantity to quote; the whole-model test is.
{
  fstat <- summary(primary_fit)$fstatistic
  cat(sprintf("Primary whole-model F(%d,%d) = %.2f, P = %.3g\n",
              fstat[2], fstat[3], fstat[1],
              stats::pf(fstat[1], fstat[2], fstat[3], lower.tail = FALSE)))
}

# --- SECONDARY: PGLS robustness, same factorial ---
# Brownian motion is excluded: with lambda fixed at 1 the covariance matrix implied
# by this tree is near-singular, so its log-likelihood and AIC are numerical
# artefacts (dAIC of about 750 below OU and Pagel) rather than evidence.
pgls_structs <- list(
  OU     = ape::corMartins(0.1, phy = tree_pruned, form = ~ Species, fixed = FALSE),
  Lambda = ape::corPagel(0.5, phy = tree_pruned, form = ~ Species, fixed = FALSE))
fit_pgls <- function(rhs, corr) tryCatch(
  nlme::gls(as.formula(paste("Cstar_Mean ~", rhs)), correlation = corr,
            data = cstar_gdc, method = "ML"), error = function(e) NULL)
pgls_fits <- list()
for (s in names(pgls_structs))
  for (nm in names(rhs_set))
    pgls_fits[[paste(s, nm, sep = "_")]] <- fit_pgls(rhs_set[[nm]], pgls_structs[[s]])
pgls_sum <- summarise_fit_set(pgls_fits)
cat("\n=== Fig. 6 SECONDARY (PGLS; Brownian excluded, near-singular): Ci* ~ fGLDP, factorial ===\n")
print(as.data.frame(pgls_sum$table), row.names = FALSE)
cat(sprintf("Selected simplest PGLS model (within dAIC<=2): %s\n", pgls_sum$best_name))

# --- 4. LME on plant-level values: supporting fit (equation, R2) ---
# Plant-level C* and fGDC, paired by Species / Plant / growth CO2.
abbrev <- function(df) df %>%
  mutate(Species = paste(stringr::str_sub(Species, 1, 1), stringr::word(Species, 2), sep = ". "))

cstar_plant <- readr::read_csv(here::here("data/processed_data/cstars.csv")) %>%
  abbrev() %>% dplyr::select(Species, Plant, GrowthCO2ppm, Cstar)
gdc_plant <- readr::read_csv(here::here("data/processed_data/allocation_data.csv")) %>%
  dplyr::rename(GrowthCO2ppm = CO2) %>% abbrev() %>%
  dplyr::select(Species, Plant, GrowthCO2ppm, BSFractionGDC)

cstar_gdc_plant <- full_join(cstar_plant, gdc_plant,
                             by = c("Species", "Plant", "GrowthCO2ppm")) %>%
  mutate(CO2 = as.factor(GrowthCO2ppm)) %>%
  filter(complete.cases(Species, Plant, BSFractionGDC, Cstar))

lme_linear <- nlme::lme(Cstar ~ BSFractionGDC,
                        random = ~ 1 | Species, data = cstar_gdc_plant, method = "ML")
lme_quad   <- nlme::lme(Cstar ~ BSFractionGDC + I(BSFractionGDC^2),
                        random = ~ 1 | Species, data = cstar_gdc_plant, method = "ML")
dAIC_lme <- AIC(lme_quad) - AIC(lme_linear)
lme_best <- if (dAIC_lme < 0) lme_quad else lme_linear
cat("\n=== LME (plant-level) ===\n")
cat("quad - linear dAIC:", round(dAIC_lme, 2),
    "| selected:", if (dAIC_lme < 0) "Quadratic" else "Linear",
    "| n plants =", nrow(cstar_gdc_plant), "\n")
print(summary(lme_best)$tTable)

# Fixed-effect equation and Nakagawa marginal / conditional R2 (random intercept)
b_lme   <- nlme::fixef(lme_best)
vc      <- nlme::VarCorr(lme_best)
var_ran <- as.numeric(vc["(Intercept)", "Variance"])
var_res <- as.numeric(vc["Residual", "Variance"])
var_fix <- var(as.numeric(predict(lme_best, level = 0)))
R2_marg <- var_fix / (var_fix + var_ran + var_res)
R2_cond <- (var_fix + var_ran) / (var_fix + var_ran + var_res)
cat("LME coefficients:\n"); print(round(b_lme, 5))
cat(sprintf("LME marginal R2 = %.2f | conditional R2 = %.2f\n", R2_marg, R2_cond))

# ----- KEY RESULTS (Fig. 6: fGLDP vs Ci*) : paste-check -----
cat("\n================= KEY RESULTS (Fig. 6) =================\n")
cat(sprintf("PRIMARY (OLS) simplest model : %s\n", primary_name))
{
  cc <- tidy_fit(primary_fit)
  for (tm in c("(Intercept)", "BSFractionGDC_Mean", "I(BSFractionGDC_Mean^2)")) {
    rw <- cc[cc$Term == tm, ]
    if (nrow(rw)) cat(sprintf("  %-24s : %.5f, p = %.4g\n", tm, rw$Estimate[1], rw$p[1]))
  }
  cat(sprintf("  R2 = %.3f | interaction retained: %s\n",
              summary(primary_fit)$r.squared, primary_has_co2))
}
cat(sprintf("SECONDARY (PGLS) simplest    : %s (Brownian excluded, near-singular)\n", pgls_sum$best_name))
{
  ps <- tidy_fit(pgls_fits[[pgls_sum$best_name]])
  for (tm in c("(Intercept)", "BSFractionGDC_Mean", "I(BSFractionGDC_Mean^2)")) {
    rw <- ps[ps$Term == tm, ]
    if (nrow(rw)) cat(sprintf("  PGLS %-24s : %.5f, p = %.4g\n", tm, rw$Estimate[1], rw$p[1]))
  }
}
cat(sprintf("LME (plant-level support)    : %s | slope %.4f, p = %.4g | marg R2 = %.2f, cond R2 = %.2f\n",
            if (dAIC_lme < 0) "Quadratic" else "Linear",
            summary(lme_best)$tTable["BSFractionGDC", "Value"],
            summary(lme_best)$tTable["BSFractionGDC", "p-value"], R2_marg, R2_cond))
cat("=======================================================\n")

# --- 5. Prediction lines -------------------------------------------
# Solid: PRIMARY (non-phylogenetic) fitted coefficients over observed fGDC range.
# If the simplest model retains the CO2 interaction, one line per CO2 level;
# otherwise a single pooled line.
xr6 <- seq(min(cstar_gdc$BSFractionGDC_Mean), max(cstar_gdc$BSFractionGDC_Mean),
           length.out = 200)
if (primary_has_co2) {
  fit_line <- expand.grid(BSFractionGDC_Mean = xr6, CO2 = levels(cstar_gdc$CO2))
  fit_line$CO2 <- factor(fit_line$CO2, levels = levels(cstar_gdc$CO2))
  fit_line$CO2grp <- as.character(fit_line$CO2)
} else {
  fit_line <- tibble::tibble(BSFractionGDC_Mean = xr6, CO2grp = "all")
}
fit_line$Cstar <- as.numeric(predict(primary_fit, newdata = fit_line))

# Dashed: fixed reference quadratic (Leung et al., 2024) across the full axis
ref_line <- tibble::tibble(BSFractionGDC_Mean = seq(0, 100, length.out = 200)) %>%
  mutate(Cstar = 49 + 0.0576 * BSFractionGDC_Mean - 0.00439 * BSFractionGDC_Mean^2)

# --- 6. Plot (Asp-AT panel style) ----------------------------------
cstar_gdc_legend_title <- expression(italic(C)[growth]~"(" * µmol ~ mol^-1 * ")")

cstar_gdc_fit_plot <- ggplot(cstar_gdc,
                             aes(x = BSFractionGDC_Mean, y = Cstar_Mean)) +
  geom_line(data = ref_line, aes(x = BSFractionGDC_Mean, y = Cstar),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5, colour = "black") +
  geom_line(data = fit_line, aes(x = BSFractionGDC_Mean, y = Cstar, group = CO2grp),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, linetype = "solid", linewidth = 0.5, colour = "black") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Cstar_Mean - Cstar_SE, ymax = Cstar_Mean + Cstar_SE),
                width = 0, linewidth = 0.25) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = BSFractionGDC_Mean - BSFractionGDC_SE,
                     xmax = BSFractionGDC_Mean + BSFractionGDC_SE),
                 height = 0, linewidth = 0.25) +
  # connector lines for the externalised labels (drawn under the points)
  geom_segment(data = . %>% filter(CO2 == "200" & sp_label == "1") %>%
                 mutate(x_lab = BSFractionGDC_Mean, y_lab = Cstar_Mean + 4.5),
               aes(x = x_lab, y = y_lab, xend = BSFractionGDC_Mean, yend = Cstar_Mean),
               linewidth = 0.3, colour = "black") +
  geom_segment(data = . %>% filter(CO2 == "200" & sp_label == "2") %>%
                 mutate(x_lab = BSFractionGDC_Mean + 8, y_lab = Cstar_Mean - 5),
               aes(x = x_lab, y = y_lab, xend = BSFractionGDC_Mean, yend = Cstar_Mean),
               linewidth = 0.3, colour = "black") +
  geom_segment(data = . %>% filter(CO2 == "800" & sp_label == "3") %>%
                 mutate(x_lab = BSFractionGDC_Mean + 4, y_lab = Cstar_Mean - 4.5),
               aes(x = x_lab, y = y_lab, xend = BSFractionGDC_Mean, yend = Cstar_Mean),
               linewidth = 0.3, colour = "black") +
  geom_point(aes(fill = CO2, shape = CO2), size = 4) +
  # centred number labels, excluding the ones handled specially below
  geom_text(data = . %>% filter(!((CO2 == "200" & sp_label %in% c("1", "2", "7", "10", "11")) |
                                   (CO2 == "800" & sp_label == "3"))),
            aes(label = sp_label, colour = CO2),
            size = 2.2, fontface = "bold", show.legend = FALSE) +
  # small nudges to separate overlapping black (200 uatm) labels from their white pairs
  geom_text(data = . %>% filter(CO2 == "200" & sp_label %in% c("7", "11")),
            aes(label = sp_label, colour = CO2),
            size = 2.2, fontface = "bold", nudge_y = -0.25, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(data = . %>% filter(CO2 == "200" & sp_label == "10"),
            aes(label = sp_label, colour = CO2),

             size = 2.2, fontface = "bold", colour = "black",
             fill = "white", label.size = 0, label.padding = unit(0.5, "pt"), show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_label(data = . %>% filter(CO2 == "200" & sp_label == "2") %>%
               mutate(x_lab = BSFractionGDC_Mean + 8, y_lab = Cstar_Mean - 5),
             aes(x = x_lab, y = y_lab, label = sp_label),
             size = 2.2, fontface = "bold", colour = "black",
             fill = "white", label.size = 0, label.padding = unit(0.5, "pt"), show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_label(data = . %>% filter(CO2 == "800" & sp_label == "3") %>%
               mutate(x_lab = BSFractionGDC_Mean + 4, y_lab = Cstar_Mean - 4.5),

             size = 2.2, fontface = "bold", colour = "black",
```
