```{r pgls_gdc_cstar}
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 100), breaks = seq(0, 100, 20), expand = expansion(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 60), breaks = seq(0, 60, 10), expand = expansion(0, 0)) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(21, 22)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("black", "white")) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("white", "black")) +
  labs(x = "BS fraction of GLDP, <i>f</i><sub>GLDP</sub> (%)",
       y = "<i>C</i><sub>i</sub>* (µmol mol<sup>-1</sup>)",
       fill = cstar_gdc_legend_title,

  theme(axis.title.x = element_markdown(lineheight = 1.2),
        axis.title.y = element_markdown(lineheight = 1.2),
```

# PLME / LME - Reaction Norms

```{r plme}

# Load reaction norm data and run PLME + LME analyses
  
  anatomy_table <- readr::read_csv(here::here("data/processed_data/allocation_data_summary.csv"))
  biochem_table <- readr::read_csv(here::here("data/processed_data/chlrates_summary.csv"))

photosynthetic_types <- readxl::read_xlsx(here::here("data", "photosynthetic_types.xlsx")) %>%
  mutate(Species = paste(stringr::str_sub(Species, 1, 1), stringr::word(Species, 2), sep = ". "),
         PhotosyntheticType = PhotosyntheticType %>% stringr::str_replace("(\\d)", "[\\1]"),
         PhotosyntheticType = ifelse(stringr::str_detect(PhotosyntheticType, "-"), "`sub-`*C[2]", PhotosyntheticType),
         PhotosyntheticType = factor(PhotosyntheticType, levels = c("C[3]", "PK", "`sub-`*C[2]", "C[2]")))


# --- 1. PREPARE ANATOMY ---
anatomy_clean <- anatomy_table %>%
  dplyr::rename(GrowthCO2ppm = CO2) %>%
  dplyr::select(Species, GrowthCO2ppm, 
                VacuolePARatio_Mean, 
                VacuoleCircularity_Mean,
                BSFractionGDC_Mean, 
                BSFractionChloroArea_Mean,

                DotsPerMitoArea_Mean,

# --- 2. PREPARE BIOCHEM (Pivot Wider) ---
biochem_clean <- biochem_table %>%
  dplyr::select(Species, GrowthCO2ppm, Enzyme, Rate_mmol_molchl_s_mean) %>%
  mutate(Enzyme = stringr::str_remove(Enzyme, "_|-")) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = Enzyme,

  )

                InitialSlope_Mean, Rd_Mean)

plme_alltraits <- anatomy_clean %>%
  dplyr::full_join(biochem_clean, by = c("Species", "GrowthCO2ppm")) %>%

tree <- ape::read.tree(here::here("data/co2_species_tree.tre"))

tree$tip.label <- tree$tip.label %>%
  stringr::str_replace("_", " ") %>%

tree$node.label <- NULL


# ===================================================================
# DEFINE ALL TRAITS TO TEST
# ===================================================================

library(ape)
library(nlme)
library(emmeans)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

traits_to_test <- tibble::tribble(
  ~trait_name,                  ~hypothesis_direction,
  # Gas exchange
  "Gamma_Mean",                 "less",
  "GammaLowLight_Mean",                 "less",
  "Cstar_Mean",                 "less",
  "InitialSlope_Mean",          "greater",
  "Rd_Mean",                    "two.sided",
  # Enzyme activities
  "ActivityAlaAT",            "greater",
  "ActivityAspAT",            "greater",
  "ActivityNADME",            "greater",
  "ActivityNADPME",           "greater",
  "ActivityPEPC",              "greater",
  # Ultrastructure
  "BSFractionChloroArea_Mean",  "greater",
  "BSFractionGDC_Mean",         "greater",
  "BSFractionMitoArea_Mean",    "greater",
  "ChloroMitoEdgeDist_Mean",    "less",
  "DotsPerMitoArea_Mean",       "greater",
  "DotsPerMitoAreaM_Mean",      "less",
  "nChloro_Mean",               "greater",
  "nMito_Mean",                 "greater",
  "AreaChloro_Mean",            "greater",
  "AreaMito_Mean",              "greater",
  "VacuolePARatio_Mean",       "less",
  "VacuoleCircularity_Mean",   "greater",
  "MitoChloroEdgeDist_Mean",   "less",
  # Modelled parameters
  "Abs_at_Ambient_Cm_Mean",     "greater",
  "Gly_Shuttle_Rate_Mean",      "greater",
  "L_Mean",                     "less",
  "V_cmax_Mean",                "greater",
  "g_bs_Mean",                  "less",
  "C_bs_Mean",                  "greater"
)


# ===================================================================
# PLME ANALYSIS LOOP (SUPPLEMENTARY)
# ===================================================================

results_list <- list()

for (i in 1:nrow(traits_to_test)) {
  
  current_trait <- traits_to_test$trait_name[i]
  current_direction <- traits_to_test$hypothesis_direction[i]
  
  print(paste("Running PLME for:", current_trait))
  
  loop_data <- plme_alltraits %>%
    dplyr::select(Species, PhotosyntheticType, GrowthCO2ppm, all_of(current_trait)) %>%
    na.omit()
  
  tryCatch({
    
    f <- as.formula(paste("`", current_trait, "`", "~ PhotosyntheticType * GrowthCO2ppm", sep = ""))
    
    # 1. Brownian Motion PLME
    bm_corr <- ape::corBrownian(phy = tree, form = ~Species)
    fit_bm <- nlme::lme(
      fixed = f, 
      random = ~ 1 | Species,
      correlation = bm_corr,
      data = loop_data,
      method = "ML"
    )
    aic_bm <- AIC(fit_bm)
    
    # 2. Ornstein-Uhlenbeck PLME
    fit_ou <- NULL
    aic_ou <- NA
    tryCatch({
      ou_corr <- ape::corMartins(value = 0.1, phy = tree, form = ~Species, fixed = FALSE)
      fit_ou <- nlme::lme(
        fixed = f,
        random = ~ 1 | Species,
        correlation = ou_corr,
        data = loop_data,
        method = "ML"
      )
      aic_ou <- AIC(fit_ou)
    }, error = function(e) {
      message(paste("  OU model failed for", current_trait))
    })
    
    # 3. Pagel's Lambda PLME
    fit_lambda <- NULL
    aic_lambda <- NA
    tryCatch({
      lambda_corr <- ape::corPagel(value = 0.5, phy = tree, form = ~Species, fixed = FALSE)
      fit_lambda <- nlme::lme(
        fixed = f,
        random = ~ 1 | Species,
        correlation = lambda_corr,
        data = loop_data,
        method = "ML"
      )
      aic_lambda <- AIC(fit_lambda)
    }, error = function(e) {
      message(paste("  Lambda model failed for", current_trait))
    })
    
    # 4. Select best model
    aic_values <- c(BM = aic_bm, OU = aic_ou, Lambda = aic_lambda)
    aic_values <- aic_values[!is.na(aic_values)]
    best_model_name <- names(which.min(aic_values))
    
    fit <- switch(best_model_name,
                  "BM" = fit_bm, "OU" = fit_ou, "Lambda" = fit_lambda)
    
    model_params <- switch(best_model_name,
                          "BM" = "Brownian Motion",
                          "OU" = paste0("OU (alpha=", round(coef(fit$modelStruct$corStruct, unconstrained=FALSE), 3), ")"),
                          "Lambda" = paste0("Lambda (λ=", round(coef(fit$modelStruct$corStruct, unconstrained=FALSE), 3), ")"))
    
    # Contrasts
    emm <- emmeans::emmeans(fit, ~ GrowthCO2ppm | PhotosyntheticType)
    contrast_df <- as.data.frame(summary(pairs(emm), adjust = "none"))
    
    contrast_df <- contrast_df %>%
      mutate(
        Trait = current_trait,
        Hypothesis = current_direction,
        Model = paste0("PLME_", best_model_name),
        Model_Details = model_params,
        AIC_BM = round(aic_bm, 2),
        AIC_OU = ifelse(is.na(aic_ou), NA, round(aic_ou, 2)),
        AIC_Lambda = ifelse(is.na(aic_lambda), NA, round(aic_lambda, 2)),
        p.value.one.sided = case_when(
          Hypothesis == "less" & t.ratio < 0 ~ p.value / 2,
          Hypothesis == "less" & t.ratio > 0 ~ 1 - (p.value / 2),
          Hypothesis == "greater" & t.ratio > 0 ~ p.value / 2,
          Hypothesis == "greater" & t.ratio < 0 ~ 1 - (p.value / 2),
          TRUE ~ p.value
        )
      ) %>%
      dplyr::select(Trait, PhotosyntheticType, contrast, estimate, SE, df, 
                   t.ratio, p.value, p.value.one.sided, Hypothesis,
                   Model, Model_Details, AIC_BM, AIC_OU, AIC_Lambda)
    
    results_list[[i]] <- contrast_df
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    message(paste("Error fitting PLME for", current_trait, ":", e$message))
  })
}

final_plme_table <- dplyr::bind_rows(results_list) %>%
  mutate(p.signif = ifelse(p.value < 0.05, "*", ""),
         p.one.sided.signif = ifelse(p.value.one.sided < 0.05, "*", ""))

write.csv(final_plme_table, "data/processed_data/plme_results_summary.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Lookup to match LME names to PLME names
trait_name_lookup <- tibble::tribble(
  ~lme_name,                ~plme_name,
  "Gamma",                  "Gamma_Mean",
  "GammaLowLight",                  "GammaLowLight_Mean",
  "Cstar",                  "Cstar_Mean",
  "InitialSlope",           "InitialSlope_Mean",
  "Rd", "Rd_Mean",
  "ActivityAlaAT",        "ActivityAlaAT",
  "ActivityAspAT",        "ActivityAspAT",
  "ActivityNADME",        "ActivityNADME",
  "ActivityNADPME",       "ActivityNADPME",
  "ActivityPEPC",          "ActivityPEPC",
  "BSFractionChloroArea",   "BSFractionChloroArea_Mean",
  "BSFractionGDC",          "BSFractionGDC_Mean",
  "BSFractionMitoArea",     "BSFractionMitoArea_Mean",
  "ChloroMitoEdgeDist",     "ChloroMitoEdgeDist_Mean",
  "DotsPerMitoArea",        "DotsPerMitoArea_Mean",
  "DotsPerMitoAreaM",       "DotsPerMitoAreaM_Mean",
  "VacuolePARatio",       "VacuolePARatio_Mean",
  "VacuoleCircularity",   "VacuoleCircularity_Mean",
  "MitoChloroEdgeDist",   "MitoChloroEdgeDist_Mean",
  "nChloro",       "nChloro_Mean",
  "nMito",         "nMito_Mean",
  "AreaChloro",    "AreaChloro_Mean",
  "AreaMito",      "AreaMito_Mean",
  "Abs_at_Ambient_Cm",      "Abs_at_Ambient_Cm_Mean",
  "Gly_Shuttle_Rate",       "Gly_Shuttle_Rate_Mean",
  "L",                      "L_Mean",
  "V_cmax",                 "V_cmax_Mean",
  "g_bs",                   "g_bs_Mean",
  "C_bs",                   "C_bs_Mean"
)


# ===================================================================
# LME ANALYSIS LOOP
# ===================================================================

lme_results_list <- list()

for (i in 1:nrow(lme_traits_to_test)) {
  
  current_trait <- lme_traits_to_test$trait_name[i]
  current_direction <- lme_traits_to_test$hypothesis_direction[i]
  
  print(paste("Running LME for:", current_trait))
  
  loop_data <- lme_alltraits %>%
    dplyr::select(Species, PhotosyntheticType, GrowthCO2ppm, 
                  Chamber,
                  all_of(current_trait)) %>%
    na.omit()
  
  print(paste("  n =", nrow(loop_data), "observations"))
  
  tryCatch({
    
    f <- as.formula(paste("`", current_trait, "`", "~ PhotosyntheticType * GrowthCO2ppm", sep = ""))
    
    fit_lme <- nlme::lme( #Lower AIC consistently
      fixed = f,
      random = ~ 1 | Species,
      data = loop_data,
      method = "ML"
    )
    # fit_lme_chamb <- nlme::lme(
    #   fixed = f,
    #   random = ~ 1 | Chamber/Species,
    #   data = loop_data,
    #   method = "ML"
    # )
    
    aic_lme <- AIC(fit_lme)
    print(paste("  LME AIC:", round(aic_lme, 2), " df:", fit_lme$fixDF$terms[1]))
    
    emm_lme <- emmeans::emmeans(fit_lme, ~ GrowthCO2ppm | PhotosyntheticType)
    contrast_lme_df <- as.data.frame(summary(pairs(emm_lme), adjust = "none"))
    
    plme_trait_name <- trait_name_lookup$plme_name[trait_name_lookup$lme_name == current_trait]
    
    contrast_lme_df <- contrast_lme_df %>%
      mutate(
        Trait = plme_trait_name,
        Trait_LME = current_trait,
        Hypothesis = current_direction,
        Model = "LME",
        Model_Details = "Species random intercept (no phylogeny)",
        AIC = round(aic_lme, 2),
        p.value.one.sided = case_when(
          Hypothesis == "less" & t.ratio < 0 ~ p.value / 2,
          Hypothesis == "less" & t.ratio > 0 ~ 1 - (p.value / 2),
          Hypothesis == "greater" & t.ratio > 0 ~ p.value / 2,
          Hypothesis == "greater" & t.ratio < 0 ~ 1 - (p.value / 2),
          TRUE ~ p.value
        )
      ) %>%
      dplyr::select(Trait, Trait_LME, PhotosyntheticType, contrast, estimate, SE, df,
                    t.ratio, p.value, p.value.one.sided, Hypothesis,
                    Model, Model_Details, AIC)
    
    lme_results_list[[i]] <- contrast_lme_df
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    message(paste("Error fitting LME for", current_trait, ":", e$message))
  })
}

# ===================================================================
# COMBINE AND SAVE
# ===================================================================

final_lme_table <- dplyr::bind_rows(lme_results_list) %>%
  mutate(p.signif = ifelse(p.value < 0.05, "*", ""),
         p.one.sided.signif = ifelse(p.value.one.sided < 0.05, "*", ""))

write.csv(final_lme_table, "data/processed_data/lme_results_summary.csv", row.names = FALSE)


# ===================================================================
# COMPARE PLME vs LME

comparison_table <- bind_rows(
  final_plme_table %>%
    dplyr::select(Trait, PhotosyntheticType, estimate, SE, df,
           t.ratio, p.value.one.sided, Model) %>%
    rename(p.one.sided = p.value.one.sided),
  final_lme_table %>%
    dplyr::select(Trait, PhotosyntheticType, estimate, SE, df,
           t.ratio, p.value.one.sided, Model) %>%
    rename(p.one.sided = p.value.one.sided)
) %>%
  mutate(signif = ifelse(p.one.sided < 0.05, "*", "")) %>%
  arrange(Trait, PhotosyntheticType, Model)

write.csv(comparison_table, "data/processed_data/plme_vs_lme_comparison.csv", row.names = FALSE)

comparison_wide <- comparison_table %>%
  dplyr::select(Trait, PhotosyntheticType, Model, signif) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Model, values_from = signif)

plme_col <- names(comparison_wide)[grepl("PLME", names(comparison_wide))][1]
comparison_wide <- comparison_wide %>%
  mutate(Agreement = ifelse(LME == .data[[plme_col]], "Yes", "DIFFERS"))

print("=== PLME vs LME: Full Comparison ===")
print(comparison_wide, n = nrow(comparison_wide))
print(paste("Agreements:", sum(comparison_wide$Agreement == "Yes"),
            "/", nrow(comparison_wide)))



```


# Plot Norms

```{r reaction_norms_lme}

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggtext)

# ===================================================================
# SETUP
# ===================================================================

theme_set(cowplot::theme_half_open() +
            theme(legend.spacing.x = unit(3, "mm"),
                  strip.background = element_blank(),
                  panel.spacing = unit(5, "mm")))

photosynthetic_types <- readxl::read_xlsx(here::here("data", "photosynthetic_types.xlsx")) %>%
  mutate(Species = paste(stringr::str_sub(Species, 1, 1), stringr::word(Species, 2), sep = ". "),
         PhotosyntheticType = PhotosyntheticType %>% stringr::str_replace("(\\d)", "[\\1]"),
         PhotosyntheticType = ifelse(stringr::str_detect(PhotosyntheticType, "-"), "`sub-`*C[2]", PhotosyntheticType),
         PhotosyntheticType = factor(PhotosyntheticType, levels = c("C[3]", "PK", "`sub-`*C[2]", "C[2]")))

# ===================================================================
# LOAD SPECIES-MEAN DATA
# ===================================================================

anatomy_table <- readr::read_csv(here::here("data/processed_data/allocation_data_summary.csv"))
biochem_table <- readr::read_csv(here::here("data/processed_data/chlrates_summary.csv"))
cstar_gamma_table <- readr::read_csv(here::here("data/processed_data/cstar_gamma_summary.csv"))
model_fits_table <- readr::read_csv(here::here("data/processed_data/model_fits_summary.csv"))

# --- PREPARE ANATOMY ---
anatomy_clean <- anatomy_table %>%
  dplyr::rename(GrowthCO2ppm = CO2) %>%
  dplyr::select(Species, GrowthCO2ppm, 
                BSFractionGDC_Mean, 
                ChloroMitoEdgeDist_Mean,
                BSFractionMitoArea_Mean, BSFractionMitoArea_SE,
                BSFractionChloroArea_Mean, BSFractionChloroArea_SE,
                DotsPerMitoArea_Mean,
                DotsPerMitoAreaM_Mean,
                nChloro_Mean, nMito_Mean, 
                AreaChloro_Mean, AreaMito_Mean)

# --- PREPARE BIOCHEM ---
biochem_clean <- biochem_table %>%
  dplyr::filter(Enzyme == "Asp-AT") %>%
  dplyr::select(Species, GrowthCO2ppm, Rate_mmol_molchl_s_mean) %>%
  dplyr::rename(ActivityAspAT = Rate_mmol_molchl_s_mean)

# --- PREPARE CSTAR/GAMMA ---
cstar_clean <- cstar_gamma_table %>%
  dplyr::select(Species, GrowthCO2ppm, Gamma_Mean, GammaLowLight_Mean, Cstar_Mean,
                InitialSlope_Mean, Rd_Mean)

# --- PREPARE MODEL FITS ---
model_clean <- model_fits_table %>%
  dplyr::rename(GrowthCO2ppm = CO2) %>%
  dplyr::select(Species, GrowthCO2ppm, 
                Abs_at_Ambient_Cm_Mean, 
                Gly_Shuttle_Rate_Mean, 
                g_bs_Mean,
                V_cmax_Mean,
                C_bs_Mean)

# ===================================================================
# BUILD SPECIES-LEVEL MERGED TABLE
# ===================================================================

species_alltraits <- anatomy_clean %>%
  dplyr::full_join(biochem_clean, by = c("Species", "GrowthCO2ppm")) %>%
  dplyr::full_join(cstar_clean, by = c("Species", "GrowthCO2ppm")) %>%
  dplyr::full_join(model_clean, by = c("Species", "GrowthCO2ppm")) %>%
  dplyr::full_join(photosynthetic_types, by = "Species") %>%
  dplyr::select(-any_of(c("Genus", "Family"))) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(GrowthCO2ppm = factor(GrowthCO2ppm, levels = c(200, 800)),
                PhotosyntheticType = factor(PhotosyntheticType, 
                                            levels = c("C[3]", "PK", "`sub-`*C[2]", "C[2]")))

# ===================================================================
# BUILD PHOTOSYNTHETIC TYPE MEANS
# ===================================================================

trait_cols <- c("BSFractionGDC_Mean", "ChloroMitoEdgeDist_Mean", 
                "DotsPerMitoArea_Mean", "DotsPerMitoAreaM_Mean",
                "ActivityAspAT",
                "BSFractionMitoArea_Mean", "BSFractionMitoArea_SE",
                "BSFractionChloroArea_Mean", "BSFractionChloroArea_SE",
                "Gamma_Mean", "GammaLowLight_Mean", "Cstar_Mean", "Rd_Mean",
                "Abs_at_Ambient_Cm_Mean", "Gly_Shuttle_Rate_Mean", "g_bs_Mean", "V_cmax_Mean",
                "C_bs_Mean")

phototype_means <- species_alltraits %>%
  group_by(PhotosyntheticType, GrowthCO2ppm) %>%
  summarise(across(.cols = all_of(trait_cols),
                   .fns = list(Mean = ~ mean(., na.rm = TRUE),
                               SE = ~ sd(., na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(.))))),
            .groups = "drop")

# ===================================================================
# LOAD LME P-VALUES AND CREATE SIGNIFICANCE LETTERS
# ===================================================================

lme_results <- readr::read_csv(here::here("data/processed_data/lme_results_summary.csv"))

# Map the trait names used in LME results to the column names used in species_alltraits
# The LME Trait column uses PLME-style names (e.g., "Gamma_Mean", "BSFractionGDC_Mean")
lme_letters <- lme_results %>%
  dplyr::select(Trait, PhotosyntheticType, p.value.one.sided) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Letter = ifelse(!is.na(p.value.one.sided) & p.value.one.sided < 0.05, "*", ""),
    PhotosyntheticType = factor(PhotosyntheticType, 
                                levels = c("C[3]", "PK", "`sub-`*C[2]", "C[2]"))
  )

# Helper: get letter for a given trait
get_lme_letter <- function(trait_name) {
  lme_letters %>%
    dplyr::filter(Trait == trait_name) %>%
    dplyr::select(PhotosyntheticType, Letter)
}

# Attach letters to phototype means
gamma_letters    <- get_lme_letter("Gamma_Mean") %>% rename(GammaLetter = Letter)
gamma_lowlight_letters    <- get_lme_letter("GammaLowLight_Mean") %>% rename(GammaLowLightLetter = Letter)
cstar_letters    <- get_lme_letter("Cstar_Mean") %>% rename(CstarLetter = Letter)
rd_letters    <- get_lme_letter("Rd_Mean") %>% rename(RdLetter = Letter)
gdc_letters      <- get_lme_letter("BSFractionGDC_Mean") %>% rename(GDCLetter = Letter)
dist_letters     <- get_lme_letter("ChloroMitoEdgeDist_Mean") %>% rename(DistLetter = Letter)
# dots_bs_letters  <- get_lme_letter("DotsPerMitoArea_Mean") %>% rename(DotsBSLetter = Letter)
# dots_m_letters   <- get_lme_letter("DotsPerMitoAreaM_Mean") %>% rename(DotsMesLetter = Letter)
mito_frac_letters   <- get_lme_letter("BSFractionMitoArea_Mean") %>% rename(MitoFracLetter = Letter)
chloro_frac_letters <- get_lme_letter("BSFractionChloroArea_Mean") %>% rename(ChloroFracLetter = Letter)
asp_letters      <- get_lme_letter("ActivityAspAT") %>% rename(AspLetter = Letter)
abs_letters      <- get_lme_letter("Abs_at_Ambient_Cm_Mean") %>% rename(AbsLetter = Letter)
gly_letters      <- get_lme_letter("Gly_Shuttle_Rate_Mean") %>% rename(GlyLetter = Letter)
gbs_letters      <- get_lme_letter("g_bs_Mean") %>% rename(GbsLetter = Letter)
vcmax_letters      <- get_lme_letter("V_cmax_Mean") %>% rename(VcmaxLetter = Letter)
cbs_letters        <- get_lme_letter("C_bs_Mean") %>% rename(CbsLetter = Letter)

phototype_data <- phototype_means %>%
  left_join(gamma_letters, by = "PhotosyntheticType") %>%
  left_join(gamma_lowlight_letters, by = "PhotosyntheticType") %>%
  left_join(cstar_letters, by = "PhotosyntheticType") %>%
  left_join(rd_letters, by = "PhotosyntheticType") %>%
  left_join(gdc_letters, by = "PhotosyntheticType") %>%
  left_join(dist_letters, by = "PhotosyntheticType") %>%
  left_join(asp_letters, by = "PhotosyntheticType") %>%
  left_join(abs_letters, by = "PhotosyntheticType") %>%
  left_join(gly_letters, by = "PhotosyntheticType") %>%
  left_join(gbs_letters, by = "PhotosyntheticType") %>%
  left_join(vcmax_letters, by = "PhotosyntheticType") %>%
  left_join(cbs_letters, by = "PhotosyntheticType") %>%
  # left_join(dots_bs_letters, by = "PhotosyntheticType") %>%
  # left_join(dots_m_letters, by = "PhotosyntheticType")
  left_join(mito_frac_letters, by = "PhotosyntheticType") %>%
  left_join(chloro_frac_letters, by = "PhotosyntheticType")

# ===================================================================
# SHARED AESTHETICS
# ===================================================================

custom_colors <- c("grey", "#fde725", "#35b779", "#21918c")
custom_fills  <- c("white", "#fde725", "#35b779", "#21918c")
custom_shapes <- c(21, 22, 23, 24)

clean_theme <- theme(
  legend.position = "none",
  axis.title.x = element_blank(),
  axis.title.y = element_text(vjust = 0.5)
)

clean_theme2 <- theme(
  legend.position = "none",
  axis.title.x = element_blank(),
  axis.title.y = element_textbox_simple(
    orientation = "left-rotated", 
    halign = 0.5, 
    margin = margin(b = 8),
    width = NULL
  )
)

universal_scales <- list(
  scale_color_manual(values = custom_colors, 
                     labels = scales::parse_format()),
  scale_fill_manual(values = custom_fills, 
                     labels = scales::parse_format()),
  scale_shape_manual(values = custom_shapes, 
                     labels = scales::parse_format())
)
```

# Combine Figure 4 - Asp-AT

```{r biochem_gly_shuttle}

library(ggtext)

add_tag <- function(p, tag) {
  p + labs(tag = tag) + theme(plot.tag = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"))
}
gly_shuttle_rates <- readr::read_csv(here::here("data/processed_data/model_fits_summary.csv")) %>%
  dplyr::select(PhotosyntheticType, Species, CO2, Gly_Shuttle_Rate_Mean, Gly_Shuttle_Rate_SE)
asp_at_activities <- readr::read_csv(here::here("data/processed_data/chlrates_summary.csv")) %>%
  filter(Enzyme == "Asp-AT") %>%
  dplyr::select(Species, GrowthCO2ppm, Rateumol_area_mean, Rateumol_area_se) %>%
  rename(CO2 = GrowthCO2ppm)
gly_asp_rates <- full_join(gly_shuttle_rates, asp_at_activities) %>%
  mutate(CO2 = as.factor(CO2))

# Assign species numbers based on SP_BREAKS ordering
species_numbers <- tibble(
  Species = SP_BREAKS,
  sp_label = as.character(1:length(SP_BREAKS))
)
gly_asp_rates <- left_join(gly_asp_rates, species_numbers, by = "Species")

# Asp-AT vs glycine shuttle rate: PGLS model selection and plot (Fig. 4)

# --- Phylogeny (same tree and tip cleaning as the C*/GDC PGLS) ---
asp_tree <- ape::read.tree(here::here("data/co2_species_tree.tre"))
asp_tree$tip.label <- asp_tree$tip.label %>%
  stringr::str_replace("_", " ") %>%
  sapply(function(x) paste(stringr::str_sub(x, 1, 1), stringr::word(x, 2), sep = ". "))
asp_tree$node.label <- NULL

# Complete cases for fitting (all rows retained separately for plotting points)
asp_complete <- gly_asp_rates %>%
  filter(complete.cases(Species, Gly_Shuttle_Rate_Mean, Rateumol_area_mean, CO2))
asp_tree_pruned <- ape::keep.tip(asp_tree, unique(asp_complete$Species))

# --- Fully factorial model selection: {linear, quadratic} x {no CO2, CO2 interaction} ---
# PRIMARY  = non-phylogenetic OLS (reported, drives the plotted line).
# SECONDARY = PGLS robustness (Brownian drops out via non-finite AIC).
# Simplest model = fewest parameters within dAIC <= 2 of the best.
asp_rhs_set <- c(
  lin_noint  = "Gly_Shuttle_Rate_Mean",
  quad_noint = "Gly_Shuttle_Rate_Mean + I(Gly_Shuttle_Rate_Mean^2)",
  lin_int    = "Gly_Shuttle_Rate_Mean * CO2",
  quad_int   = "(Gly_Shuttle_Rate_Mean + I(Gly_Shuttle_Rate_Mean^2)) * CO2")

# --- PRIMARY: non-phylogenetic OLS on species x CO2 means ---
asp_lm_fits <- lapply(asp_rhs_set, function(r)
  lm(as.formula(paste("Rateumol_area_mean ~", r)), data = asp_complete))
asp_lm_sum <- summarise_fit_set(asp_lm_fits)
cat("\n=== Fig. 4 PRIMARY (non-phylogenetic OLS): Asp-AT ~ glycine shuttle, fully factorial ===\n")
print(as.data.frame(asp_lm_sum$table), row.names = FALSE)

asp_primary_name    <- asp_lm_sum$best_name
asp_primary_fit     <- asp_lm_fits[[asp_primary_name]]
asp_primary_rhs     <- asp_rhs_set[[asp_primary_name]]
asp_primary_has_co2 <- grepl("CO2", asp_primary_rhs)
cat(sprintf("\nSelected simplest primary model (fewest params within dAIC<=2): %s\n", asp_primary_name))
cat("Primary coefficient table (Estimate, SE, t, p):\n")
print(as.data.frame(tidy_fit(asp_primary_fit)), row.names = FALSE)
cat(sprintf("Primary R2 = %.3f | adjusted R2 = %.3f\n",
            summary(asp_primary_fit)$r.squared, summary(asp_primary_fit)$adj.r.squared))

# --- SECONDARY: PGLS robustness (BM excluded via non-finite AIC), same factorial ---
asp_pgls_structs <- list(
  BM     = ape::corPagel(1, phy = asp_tree_pruned, form = ~ Species, fixed = TRUE),
  OU     = ape::corMartins(0.1, phy = asp_tree_pruned, form = ~ Species, fixed = FALSE),
  Lambda = ape::corPagel(0.5, phy = asp_tree_pruned, form = ~ Species, fixed = FALSE))
asp_fit_pgls <- function(rhs, corr) tryCatch(
  nlme::gls(as.formula(paste("Rateumol_area_mean ~", rhs)), correlation = corr,
            data = asp_complete, method = "ML"), error = function(e) NULL)
asp_pgls_fits <- list()
for (s in names(asp_pgls_structs))
  for (nm in names(asp_rhs_set))
    asp_pgls_fits[[paste(s, nm, sep = "_")]] <- asp_fit_pgls(asp_rhs_set[[nm]], asp_pgls_structs[[s]])
asp_pgls_sum <- summarise_fit_set(asp_pgls_fits)
cat("\n=== Fig. 4 SECONDARY (PGLS; Brownian excluded by non-finite AIC): factorial ===\n")
print(as.data.frame(asp_pgls_sum$table), row.names = FALSE)
cat(sprintf("Selected simplest PGLS model (within dAIC<=2): %s\n", asp_pgls_sum$best_name))

# --- Plotted line from the PRIMARY (non-phylogenetic) fitted coefficients ---
asp_xr <- seq(min(asp_complete$Gly_Shuttle_Rate_Mean),
              max(asp_complete$Gly_Shuttle_Rate_Mean), length.out = 200)
if (asp_primary_has_co2) {
  asp_fit_line <- expand.grid(Gly_Shuttle_Rate_Mean = asp_xr, CO2 = levels(asp_complete$CO2))
  asp_fit_line$CO2 <- factor(asp_fit_line$CO2, levels = levels(asp_complete$CO2))
  asp_fit_line$CO2grp <- as.character(asp_fit_line$CO2)
} else {
  asp_fit_line <- tibble::tibble(Gly_Shuttle_Rate_Mean = asp_xr, CO2grp = "all")
}
asp_fit_line$Rateumol_area_mean <- as.numeric(predict(asp_primary_fit, newdata = asp_fit_line))

# --- KEY RESULTS (Fig. 4): paste-check ---
cat("\n================= KEY RESULTS (Fig. 4) =================\n")
cat(sprintf("PRIMARY (OLS) simplest model : %s\n", asp_primary_name))
{
  cc  <- tidy_fit(asp_primary_fit)
  gl  <- cc[cc$Term == "Gly_Shuttle_Rate_Mean", ]
  gl2 <- cc[cc$Term == "I(Gly_Shuttle_Rate_Mean^2)", ]
  ix  <- cc[grepl(":CO2", cc$Term), ]
  if (nrow(gl))  cat(sprintf("  glycine shuttle rate   : %.4f, p = %.4g\n", gl$Estimate[1],  gl$p[1]))
  if (nrow(gl2)) cat(sprintf("  glycine shuttle rate^2 : %.4f, p = %.4g\n", gl2$Estimate[1], gl2$p[1]))
  if (nrow(ix))  cat(sprintf("  CO2 interaction term   : %.4f, p = %.4g\n", ix$Estimate[1], ix$p[1]))
  cat(sprintf("  R2 = %.3f | interaction retained: %s\n",
              summary(asp_primary_fit)$r.squared, asp_primary_has_co2))
}
cat(sprintf("SECONDARY (PGLS) simplest    : %s (Brownian excluded, non-finite AIC)\n", asp_pgls_sum$best_name))
{
  ps <- tidy_fit(asp_pgls_fits[[asp_pgls_sum$best_name]])
  gl <- ps[ps$Term == "Gly_Shuttle_Rate_Mean", ]
  if (nrow(gl)) cat(sprintf("  PGLS glycine slope : %.4f, p = %.4g\n", gl$Estimate[1], gl$p[1]))
}
cat("=======================================================\n")

# --- Save model-selection tables ---
readr::write_csv(
  dplyr::bind_rows(
    asp_lm_sum$meta   %>% dplyr::mutate(Framework = "OLS_primary"),
    asp_pgls_sum$meta %>% dplyr::mutate(Framework = "PGLS_secondary")) %>%
    dplyr::relocate(Framework),
  here::here("data/processed_data/asp_at_model_selection.csv"))
readr::write_csv(dplyr::mutate(tidy_fit(asp_primary_fit), model = asp_primary_name),
                 here::here("data/processed_data/asp_at_primary_coefs.csv"))
gly_asp_legend_title <- expression(italic(C)[growth]~"(" * µmol ~ mol^-1 * ")")
gly_asp_plot <- ggplot(gly_asp_rates, 
                       aes(x = Gly_Shuttle_Rate_Mean, y = Rateumol_area_mean)) +
  geom_line(data = asp_fit_line,
            aes(x = Gly_Shuttle_Rate_Mean, y = Rateumol_area_mean, group = CO2grp),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.5, colour = "black") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Rateumol_area_mean - Rateumol_area_se,
                    ymax = Rateumol_area_mean + Rateumol_area_se), width = 0, linewidth = 0.25) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = Gly_Shuttle_Rate_Mean - Gly_Shuttle_Rate_SE,
                     xmax = Gly_Shuttle_Rate_Mean + Gly_Shuttle_Rate_SE), height = 0, linewidth = 0.25) +
  geom_segment(data = . %>% filter(CO2 == "200" & sp_label == "1") %>%
                 mutate(x_lab = 1, y_lab = 23),
               aes(x = x_lab, y = y_lab, xend = Gly_Shuttle_Rate_Mean, yend = Rateumol_area_mean),
               linewidth = 0.3, colour = "black") +
  geom_segment(data = . %>% filter(CO2 == "200" & sp_label == "3") %>%
                 mutate(x_lab = 1, y_lab = 16),
               aes(x = x_lab, y = y_lab, xend = Gly_Shuttle_Rate_Mean, yend = Rateumol_area_mean),
               linewidth = 0.3, colour = "black") +
  geom_segment(data = . %>% filter(CO2 == "200" & sp_label == "2") %>%
                 mutate(x_lab = 0.75, y_lab = 10),
               aes(x = x_lab, y = y_lab, xend = Gly_Shuttle_Rate_Mean, yend = Rateumol_area_mean),
               linewidth = 0.3, colour = "black") +
  geom_point(aes(fill = CO2, shape = CO2), size = 4) +
  # Default labels: all points except black 1,2,3,6
  geom_text(data = . %>% filter(!(CO2 == "200" & sp_label %in% c("1", "2", "3", "6"))),
            aes(label = sp_label, colour = CO2),
            size = 2.2, fontface = "bold", show.legend = FALSE) +
  # Manual labels for black 1, 2, 3
  geom_label(data = . %>% filter(CO2 == "200" & sp_label == "1") %>%
               mutate(x_lab = 1, y_lab = 23),
             aes(x = x_lab, y = y_lab, label = sp_label),
             size = 2.2, fontface = "bold", colour = "black",
             fill = "white", label.size = 0, label.padding = unit(0.5, "pt"),
             show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_label(data = . %>% filter(CO2 == "200" & sp_label == "2") %>%
               mutate(x_lab = 1, y_lab = 16),
             aes(x = x_lab, y = y_lab, label = sp_label),
             size = 2.2, fontface = "bold", colour = "black",
             fill = "white", label.size = 0, label.padding = unit(0.5, "pt"),
             show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_label(data = . %>% filter(CO2 == "200" & sp_label == "3") %>%
               mutate(x_lab = 0.75, y_lab = 10),
             aes(x = x_lab, y = y_lab, label = sp_label),
             size = 2.2, fontface = "bold", colour = "black",
             fill = "white", label.size = 0, label.padding = unit(0.5, "pt"),
             show.legend = FALSE) +
  # Nudge label for black 6 up
  geom_text(data = . %>% filter(CO2 == "200" & sp_label == "6"),
            aes(label = sp_label, colour = CO2),
            size = 2.2, fontface = "bold", nudge_y = 0.5, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 10), breaks = seq(0, 10, 2), expand = expansion(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 120), breaks = seq(0, 120, 20), expand = expansion(0, 0)) +
```

# Figure 6 Phenotypic PCA

## Load data

```{r pca_all}
anatomy_table <- readr::read_csv(here::here("data/processed_data/allocation_data_summary.csv"))
biochem_table <- readr::read_csv(here::here("data/processed_data/chlrates_summary.csv"))
cstar_gamma_table <- readr::read_csv(here::here("data/processed_data/cstar_gamma_summary.csv"))
model_fits_table <- readr::read_csv(here::here("data/processed_data/model_fits_summary.csv"))

photosynthetic_types <- readxl::read_xlsx(here::here("data", "photosynthetic_types.xlsx")) %>%
  mutate(Species = paste(stringr::str_sub(Species, 1, 1), stringr::word(Species, 2), sep = ". "),
         PhotosyntheticType = PhotosyntheticType %>% stringr::str_replace("(\\d)", "[\\1]"),
         PhotosyntheticType = ifelse(stringr::str_detect(PhotosyntheticType, "-"), "`sub-`*C[2]", PhotosyntheticType),
         PhotosyntheticType = factor(PhotosyntheticType, levels = c("C[3]", "PK", "`sub-`*C[2]", "C[2]")))


# --- 1. PREPARE ANATOMY ---
# Rename CO2 to match other tables and select specific columns
anatomy_clean <- anatomy_table %>%
  dplyr::rename(GrowthCO2ppm = CO2) %>%
  dplyr::select(Species, GrowthCO2ppm, 
                VacuolePARatio_Mean, 
                VacuoleCircularity_Mean,
                BSFractionGDC_Mean, 
                ChloroMitoEdgeDist_Mean, 
                MitoChloroEdgeDist_Mean,
                DotsPerMitoArea_Mean)

# --- 2. PREPARE BIOCHEM (Pivot Wider) ---
# Pivot enzyme rates to columns
biochem_clean <- biochem_table %>%
  dplyr::select(Species, GrowthCO2ppm, Enzyme, Rate_mmol_molchl_s_mean) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = Enzyme, 
    values_from = Rate_mmol_molchl_s_mean,
    names_prefix = "Activity_" # e.g. Activity_Ala-AT
  )

# --- 3. PREPARE CSTAR/GAMMA ---
# Select summary columns
cstar_clean <- cstar_gamma_table %>%
  dplyr::select(Species, GrowthCO2ppm, Gamma_Mean, 
                GammaLowLight_Mean, Cstar_Mean, Rd_Mean)

# --- 4. PREPARE MODEL FITS ---
# Rename CO2 and apply the 0.5 correction to Glycine Shuttle Rate
model_clean <- model_fits_table %>%
  dplyr::rename(GrowthCO2ppm = CO2) %>%
  dplyr::select(Species, GrowthCO2ppm, 
                Abs_at_Ambient_Cm_Mean, 
                Gly_Shuttle_Rate_Mean, 
                g_bs_Mean, 
                V_cmax_Mean, 
                L_Mean,
                C_bs_Mean)

# --- 5. MERGE ALL TRAITS ---
pca_alltraits <- anatomy_clean %>%
  dplyr::full_join(biochem_clean, by = c("Species", "GrowthCO2ppm")) %>%
  dplyr::full_join(cstar_clean, by = c("Species", "GrowthCO2ppm")) %>%
  dplyr::full_join(model_clean, by = c("Species", "GrowthCO2ppm")) %>%
  # Add Photosynthetic Type Metadata manually
  full_join(photosynthetic_types) %>%
  na.omit() # PCA cannot handle NAs

# --- 6. RUN PCA ---
# Select ALL numeric columns for the matrix (18 traits total)
pca_matrix <- pca_alltraits %>%
  dplyr::select(
    
    
    # --- Gas Exchange  ---
    Gamma_Mean, 
    GammaLowLight_Mean,
    Cstar_Mean,
    Rd_Mean,
    
    # --- Anatomy  ---
    VacuolePARatio_Mean, 
    VacuoleCircularity_Mean,
    BSFractionGDC_Mean, 
    ChloroMitoEdgeDist_Mean, 
    MitoChloroEdgeDist_Mean,
    DotsPerMitoArea_Mean,
    
    
    
    # --- Biochemistry ---
    `Activity_Asp-AT`,
    `Activity_NADP-ME`,
    
    # --- Model Fits  ---
    Abs_at_Ambient_Cm_Mean, 
    C_bs_Mean,
    Gly_Shuttle_Rate_Mean, 
    g_bs_Mean,
    V_cmax_Mean,
  )

```

## Plot PCA

``` {r pca_all_plot}
# Load required libraries for the specific plotting functions
library(ggfortify) # Needed for autoplot to recognize prcomp objects
library(ggrepel)

# --- 1. Final Data Prep for Plotting ---
# We take the combined dataframe, rename columns to match your code,
# and create the Species labels for the 800ppm points.
pca_data_summary <- pca_alltraits %>%
  dplyr::rename(CO2 = GrowthCO2ppm) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    CO2 = as.factor(CO2),
    # Create Labels: Genus + first 3 letters of species (e.g., "F. ang")
    # Only label the 800 ppm points to avoid clutter
    SpeciesLabel = ifelse(CO2 == 800,
                          paste0(stringr::word(Species, 1),
                                 stringr::word(Species, 2) %>% substr(1, 3)),
                          "")
  )

# --- 2. Run PCA ---
# Select only numeric columns for the matrix
pca_matrix <- pca_data_summary %>%
  dplyr::select(ChloroMitoEdgeDist_Mean,
                VacuoleCircularity_Mean,
                BSFractionGDC_Mean,
                DotsPerMitoArea_Mean,
                `Activity_Asp-AT`,
                `Activity_NADP-ME`,
                GammaLowLight_Mean,
                Gamma_Mean,
                Cstar_Mean,
                Rd_Mean,
                Abs_at_Ambient_Cm_Mean,
                C_bs_Mean,
                Gly_Shuttle_Rate_Mean,
                V_cmax_Mean,
                g_bs_Mean) %>%
  mutate(Rd_Mean = -1*Rd_Mean)

# Run PCA (Scale = TRUE is critical)
pca_model <- stats::prcomp(pca_matrix, scale. = TRUE)



# --- 7. EXTRACT SCORES & LOADINGS ---
# Scores (Where the species sit)
pca_scores_all <- as.data.frame(pca_model$x) %>%
  dplyr::bind_cols(pca_alltraits %>% dplyr::select(Species, GrowthCO2ppm, PhotosyntheticType)) %>%
  dplyr::rename(CO2 = GrowthCO2ppm)

# Loadings (Which traits drive the axes)
pca_loadings_all <- as.data.frame(pca_model$rotation) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("Variable")

# --- 8. SAVE ---
readr::write_csv(pca_scores_all, here::here("data/processed_data/pca_scores_all_traits.csv"))
readr::write_csv(pca_loadings_all, here::here("data/processed_data/pca_loadings_all_traits.csv"))

# --- 3. YOUR PLOTTING CODE ---

pca_legend_title <- expression(italic(C)[growth]~"(" * µmol ~ mol^-1 * ")")

# Plot 1: Points (No Labels)
pca_points_nolab <- autoplot(pca_model, data = pca_data_summary, fill = "CO2", shape = "CO2",
                       size = 1.5,
                       scale = 0) +
  geom_line(aes(group = Species),
            linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(21, 22))+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("black", "white")) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-4, 6), breaks = seq(-6, 6, 2), expand = expansion(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-3, 3), breaks = seq(-6, 6, 1), expand = expansion(0, 0)) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# Plot 2: Points (With Labels)
pca_points <- pca_points_nolab +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(aes(label = SpeciesLabel),
                           nudge_x = 0.1,
                           min.segment.length = Inf,
                           fontface = "italic",
                           size = 3)

# Plot 3: Arrows (Loadings)
pca_arrows <- autoplot(pca_model, data = pca_data_summary,
                       shape = FALSE,
                       label = FALSE,
                       loadings.color = "black",
                       loadings.arrow = grid::arrow(length = grid::unit(3, 'points'), type = "open"),
                       loadings.linewidth = 0.5,
                       loadings.label = TRUE,
                       loadings.label.repel = TRUE,
                       loadings.label.size = 2.5,
                       loadings.label.color = "black",
                       loadings.label.fontface = "bold",
                       size = 1,
                       scale = 0) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-2, 2), breaks = seq(-6, 6, 1), expand = expansion(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-2, 2), breaks = seq(-6, 6, 1), expand = expansion(0, 0)) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# Plot 4: Arrows (No Labels - Clean Vectors)
pca_arrows_nolab <- autoplot(pca_model, data = pca_data_summary,
                             shape = FALSE,
                             label = FALSE,
                             loadings.color = "black",
                             loadings.arrow = grid::arrow(length = grid::unit(3, 'points'), type = "open"),
                             loadings.linewidth = 0.5,
                             loadings.label = TRUE,
                             loadings.label.size = 0, # Hides labels
                             loadings.label.color = "black",
                             loadings.label.fontface = "bold",
                             size = 1,
                             scale = 0) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-2, 2), breaks = seq(-6, 6, 1), expand = expansion(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-2, 2), breaks = seq(-6, 6, 1), expand = expansion(0, 0)) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# --- 4. Print Plots ---
print(pca_points)
print(pca_arrows)

# Legend for CO2 growth treatment
p_legend_co2 <- pca_points +

  guides(linetype = "none", color = guide_legend(nrow = 1, override.aes = list(size = 3))) +
  labs(shape = expression(italic(C)[growth]~"(µmol mol"^-1*")"),
       fill = expression(italic(C)[growth]~"(µmol mol"^-1*")"))

# Build Grid: LABELED
figure4_grid <- cowplot::plot_grid(

# Build Grid: NO LABELS
```

## PCA with all traits in Tables 1, 2, and 3

``` {r pca_all_traits_supp}
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Supplementary PCA using EVERY trait reported in Tables 1-3, not only
# the significant-CO2-effect subset used in the main-text Fig. 7.
# Purpose: show that selecting traits by CO2 responsiveness fixes WHICH
# traits enter but does not impose their mutual alignment or alignment
# with the C3-to-C2 axis. Trait list and reconciled column names are
# taken verbatim from traits_to_test (the PLME loop), i.e. Table 1
# (gas exchange + enzymes), Table 2 (ultrastructure + GDC immuno), and
# Table 3 (modelled parameters). Requires the {r plme} chunk to have
# been run so plme_alltraits and traits_to_test are in scope.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
library(ggfortify)
library(ggrepel)

# --- 1. Trait set = all of Tables 1-3 (from the PLME loop) ---
all_trait_names <- traits_to_test$trait_name

# Traits whose C2-like direction is a DECREASE. Sign-flip these so that
# positive PC1 = more C2-like for every trait, matching the main Fig. 7
# convention (there Rd and the "less" traits are flipped). Rd is two-sided
# but flipped in the main PCA, so it is flipped here too for comparability.
flip_traits <- traits_to_test %>%
  dplyr::filter(hypothesis_direction == "less") %>%
  dplyr::pull(trait_name) %>%
  union("Rd_Mean")

# NOTE: ChloroMitoEdgeDist_Mean and MitoChloroEdgeDist_Mean are reciprocal
# nearest-neighbour distances (near-duplicates); both are retained here to
# reproduce Tables 1-3 exactly. Drop one if a reviewer objects to weighting.

# --- 2. Build the PCA matrix ---
pca_alltraits_full <- plme_alltraits %>%
  dplyr::rename(CO2 = GrowthCO2ppm) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(CO2 = as.factor(CO2)) %>%
  dplyr::select(Species, CO2, PhotosyntheticType, dplyr::all_of(all_trait_names)) %>%
  stats::na.omit() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(SpeciesLabel = ifelse(CO2 == 800,
                                      paste0(stringr::word(Species, 1),
                                             stringr::word(Species, 2) %>% substr(1, 3)),
                                      ""))

pca_matrix_full <- pca_alltraits_full %>%
  dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(all_trait_names)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(flip_traits), ~ -1 * .))

# --- 3. Run PCA (scale = TRUE) ---
pca_model_full <- stats::prcomp(pca_matrix_full, scale. = TRUE)

# Orient PC1 so positive = more C2-like (glycine shuttle rate as anchor),
# matching the main-text Fig. 7 convention. prcomp's PC1 sign is arbitrary.
if (cor(pca_model_full$x[, "PC1"], pca_matrix_full$Gly_Shuttle_Rate_Mean) < 0) {
  pca_model_full$rotation[, "PC1"] <- -pca_model_full$rotation[, "PC1"]
  pca_model_full$x[, "PC1"]        <- -pca_model_full$x[, "PC1"]
}

var_explained_full <- round(100 * pca_model_full$sdev^2 / sum(pca_model_full$sdev^2), 1)
cat(sprintf("All-traits PCA (%d traits): PC1 = %.1f%%, PC2 = %.1f%%\n",
            length(all_trait_names), var_explained_full[1], var_explained_full[2]))

# --- 4. Extract and save scores and loadings ---
pca_scores_full <- as.data.frame(pca_model_full$x) %>%
  dplyr::bind_cols(pca_alltraits_full %>% dplyr::select(Species, CO2, PhotosyntheticType))

pca_loadings_full <- as.data.frame(pca_model_full$rotation) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("Variable")

readr::write_csv(pca_scores_full,
                 here::here("data/processed_data/pca_scores_all_tables123.csv"))
readr::write_csv(pca_loadings_full,
                 here::here("data/processed_data/pca_loadings_all_tables123.csv"))

# --- 5. Paired one-sided PC1 shift test (200 vs 800), mirroring Fig. 7 ---
pc1_wide_full <- pca_scores_full %>%
  dplyr::select(Species, CO2, PC1) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = CO2, values_from = PC1, names_prefix = "CO2_")

pc1_test_full <- t.test(pc1_wide_full$CO2_200, pc1_wide_full$CO2_800,
                        paired = TRUE, alternative = "greater")
print(pc1_test_full)
cat("Mean PC1 shift (200 - 800), all-traits PCA:",
    round(mean(pc1_wide_full$CO2_200 - pc1_wide_full$CO2_800), 3), "\n")

# --- 6. Plot: scores (species linked by CO2) ---
pca_legend_title <- expression(italic(C)[growth]~"(" * µmol ~ mol^-1 * ")")

pca_points_full_nolab <- autoplot(pca_model_full, data = pca_alltraits_full,
                                  fill = "CO2", shape = "CO2", size = 1.5, scale = 0) +
  geom_line(aes(group = Species), linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(21, 22)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("black", "white")) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

pca_points_full <- pca_points_full_nolab +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(aes(label = SpeciesLabel),
                           nudge_x = 0.1, min.segment.length = Inf,
                           fontface = "italic", size = 3) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-6, 8), breaks = seq(-6, 8, 2)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-4, 4), breaks = seq(-4, 4, 2))

# --- 7. Plot: loadings, numbered 1-28 to match caption ---
# Numbers follow the order of all_trait_names (= traits_to_test = Tables 1,2,3).
# Build the arrows layer manually so labels are row numbers, not variable names.
loadings_df <- as.data.frame(pca_model_full$rotation[, c("PC1", "PC2")]) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("Variable") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Number = dplyr::row_number())

# Save the number-to-trait key for the caption
readr::write_csv(loadings_df %>% dplyr::select(Number, Variable),
                 here::here("data/processed_data/pca_all_traits_loading_key.csv"))

# Scale arrows to sit within the score cloud.
arrow_scale <- 0.9 * max(abs(pca_model_full$x[, c("PC1", "PC2")])) /
  max(abs(as.matrix(loadings_df[, c("PC1", "PC2")])))

loadings_scaled <- loadings_df %>%
  dplyr::mutate(PC1 = PC1 * arrow_scale, PC2 = PC2 * arrow_scale)

# Base arrows layer, shared by labelled and nolab versions
arrows_base <- ggplot() +
  geom_segment(data = loadings_scaled,
               aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = PC1, yend = PC2),
               arrow = grid::arrow(length = grid::unit(3, "points"), type = "open"),
               linewidth = 0.5, color = "black") +
  labs(x = sprintf("PC1 (%.1f%%)", var_explained_full[1]),
       y = sprintf("PC2 (%.1f%%)", var_explained_full[2])) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# Labelled (numbers via ggrepel)
pca_arrows_full <- arrows_base +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(data = loadings_scaled,
                           aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, label = Number),
                           size = 3, fontface = "bold", color = "black",
                           min.segment.length = 0, segment.size = 0.2,
                           box.padding = 0.15, max.overlaps = Inf)

# No-label (arrows only, for Inkscape)
pca_arrows_full_nolab <- arrows_base

print(pca_points_full)
print(pca_arrows_full)

p_legend_co2_full <- pca_points_full +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.justification = "center",
        legend.text = element_text(size = 12)) +
  guides(linetype = "none", color = guide_legend(nrow = 1, override.aes = list(size = 3))) +
  labs(shape = pca_legend_title, fill = pca_legend_title)

# Labelled grid
supp_pca_grid <- cowplot::plot_grid(
  pca_points_full, NULL, pca_arrows_full,
  rel_widths = c(1, 0.05, 1),
  labels = c("(a)", "", "(b)"),
  label_size = 20, hjust = 0, align = "hv", axis = "tblr", ncol = 3) %>%
  cowplot::plot_grid(cowplot::get_legend(p_legend_co2_full), .,
                     ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(0.1, 1))

# No-label grid (for Inkscape)
supp_pca_grid_nolab <- cowplot::plot_grid(
  pca_points_full_nolab, NULL, pca_arrows_full_nolab,
  rel_widths = c(1, 0.05, 1),
  labels = c("(a)", "", "(b)"),
  label_size = 20, hjust = 0, align = "hv", axis = "tblr", ncol = 3) %>%
  cowplot::plot_grid(cowplot::get_legend(p_legend_co2_full), .,
                     ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(0.1, 1))

ggsave(here::here("figures", "FigureS10_PCA_all_trait.pdf"),
       supp_pca_grid, width = 8.5, height = 4.5, dpi = 600)
ggsave(here::here("figures", "FigureS10_PCA_all_trait_nolab.svg"),
       supp_pca_grid_nolab, width = 8.5, height = 4.5, dpi = 600)

```


## Density plot

``` {r pc1_density}

library(cowplot)
# --- 1. PREPARE DENSITY DATA ---
# Use the scores from the correct model to match the biplot
pca_scores_fig <- as.data.frame(pca_model$x) %>%
  bind_cols(pca_data_summary) %>% 
  full_join(photosynthetic_types) %>%
  mutate(
    PhotosyntheticType = factor(PhotosyntheticType, 
                                levels = c("C[3]", "PK", "`sub-`*C[2]", "C[2]"))
  )

# --- Paired t-test: PC1 shift under low CO2 ---
pc1_wide <- pca_scores_fig %>%
  dplyr::select(Species, CO2, PC1) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = CO2, values_from = PC1, names_prefix = "CO2_")

# One-sided: does low CO2 shift PC1 toward positive (more C2-like)?
pc1_test <- t.test(pc1_wide$CO2_200, pc1_wide$CO2_800, 
                   paired = TRUE, alternative = "greater")
print(pc1_test)

# Effect size: mean shift
cat("Mean PC1 shift (200 - 800):", 
    mean(pc1_wide$CO2_200 - pc1_wide$CO2_800), "\n")

type_colors <- c("grey", "#fde725", "#35b779", "#21918c")
plot_limits <- c(-4, 6) # Match your biplot X-axis

# A. Calculate Full Curves
range_800 <- range(pca_scores_fig$PC1[pca_scores_fig$CO2 == 800])
range_200 <- range(pca_scores_fig$PC1[pca_scores_fig$CO2 == 200])

common_density <- function(data, co2_level) {
  subset_vals <- data %>% filter(CO2 == co2_level) %>% pull(PC1)
  d <- density(subset_vals, from = plot_limits[1], to = plot_limits[2], n = 512, bw = 0.6)
  tibble(x = d$x, y = d$y, CO2 = as.factor(co2_level))
}

raw_dens_800 <- common_density(pca_scores_fig, 800)
raw_dens_200 <- common_density(pca_scores_fig, 200)

# B. Data for Panel C (Separate Clipped Lines)
dens_separate <- bind_rows(
  raw_dens_800 %>% filter(x %>% between(min(range_800), max(range_800))),
  raw_dens_200 %>% filter(x %>% between(min(range_200), max(range_200)))
)

raw_dens_ranges <- c(range_200, range_800)

# C. Data for Panel D (MEAN Density)
# Calculate the average of y-values across the grid
dens_mean <- tibble(
  x = raw_dens_800$x,
  y = (raw_dens_800$y + raw_dens_200$y) / 2
) %>%
  filter(x %>% between(min(raw_dens_ranges), max(raw_dens_ranges)))

# --- 2. PLOT PANEL C: SEPARATE LINES ---
p_separate <- ggplot(dens_separate, aes(x = x, y = y)) +
  geom_line(aes(linetype = CO2), linewidth = 0.5) +
  
  # Rugs
  geom_rug(data = pca_scores_fig %>% filter(CO2 == 200), 
           aes(x = PC1, color = PhotosyntheticType), 
           inherit.aes = FALSE, sides = "t", length = unit(0.05, "npc"), linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_rug(data = pca_scores_fig %>% filter(CO2 == 800), 
           aes(x = PC1, color = PhotosyntheticType), 
           inherit.aes = FALSE, sides = "b", length = unit(0.05, "npc"), linewidth = 0.5) +
  
  # Labels
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(data = dens_separate %>% group_by(CO2) %>% slice_max(y),
                           aes(label = CO2), nudge_y = 0.01, min.segment.length = Inf) +
  
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("dotted", "solid")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = type_colors, labels = scales::parse_format()) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-4, 6), breaks = seq(-6, 6, 2), expand = expansion(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 0.25), breaks = seq(0, 2.5, 0.05), expand = expansion(0)) +
  
  labs(x = "Leaf phenotypic PC1", y = "Density") +
  theme_cowplot() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# --- 3. PLOT PANEL D: MEAN DENSITY ---
p_mean <- ggplot(dens_mean, aes(x = x, y = y)) +
  # Single Black Line (No Fill)
  geom_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
  
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-4, 6), breaks = seq(-6, 6, 2), expand = expansion(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 0.25), breaks = seq(0, 2.5, 0.05), expand = expansion(0)) +
  
  
  labs(y = "Mean density", x = "Leaf phenotypic PC1") +
  theme_cowplot() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")


# --- 4. ASSEMBLE FIGURE ---
# Extract Legend
p_legend_source <- p_separate + 
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.justification = "center", legend.text = element_text(size = 12)) +
  guides(linetype = "none", color = guide_legend(title = NULL, nrow = 1, override.aes = list(size = 3)))
figure4_legend <- cowplot::get_legend(p_legend_source)


```

```{r figure3}
library(cowplot)
# ggsave(here::here("figures/pca", "PCA.png"),
```

# Table 1- combine All tables

```{r}

# 1. Read the four tables
#####

anatomy_table <- readr::read_csv(here::here("data/processed_data/allocation_data_summary.csv"))
biochem_table <- readr::read_csv(here::here("data/processed_data/chlrates_summary.csv"))
cstar_gamma_table <- readr::read_csv(here::here("data/processed_data/cstar_gamma_summary.csv"))
model_fits_table <- readr::read_csv(here::here("data/processed_data/model_fits_summary.csv"))

photosynthetic_types <- readxl::read_xlsx(here::here("data", "photosynthetic_types.xlsx")) %>%
  mutate(Species = paste(stringr::str_sub(Species, 1, 1), stringr::word(Species, 2), sep = ". "),
         PhotosyntheticType = PhotosyntheticType %>% stringr::str_replace("(\\d)", "[\\1]"),
         PhotosyntheticType = ifelse(stringr::str_detect(PhotosyntheticType, "-"), "`sub-`*C[2]", PhotosyntheticType),
         PhotosyntheticType = factor(PhotosyntheticType, levels = c("C[3]", "PK", "`sub-`*C[2]", "C[2]")))


# --- 1. PREPARE ANATOMY ---
anatomy_clean <- anatomy_table %>%
  dplyr::rename(GrowthCO2ppm = CO2) %>%
  dplyr::select(Species, GrowthCO2ppm, 
                VacuolePARatio_Mean, 
                VacuoleCircularity_Mean,
                BSFractionGDC_Mean, 
                ChloroMitoEdgeDist_Mean, 
                MitoChloroEdgeDist_Mean,
                DotsPerMitoArea_Mean,
                DotsPerMitoAreaM_Mean, 
                BSFractionChloroArea_Mean, 
                BSFractionMitoArea_Mean, 
                nChloro_Mean, nMito_Mean, 
                AreaChloro_Mean, AreaMito_Mean)

# --- 2. PREPARE BIOCHEM (Pivot Wider) ---
biochem_clean <- biochem_table %>%
  dplyr::select(Species, GrowthCO2ppm, Enzyme, Rate_mmol_molchl_s_mean) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = Enzyme, 
    values_from = Rate_mmol_molchl_s_mean,
    names_prefix = "Activity"
  )

# --- 3. PREPARE CSTAR/GAMMA ---
cstar_clean <- cstar_gamma_table %>%
  dplyr::select(Species, GrowthCO2ppm, Gamma_Mean, GammaLowLight_Mean, Cstar_Mean,
                InitialSlope_Mean, Rd_Mean)

# --- 4. PREPARE MODEL FITS ---
model_clean <- model_fits_table %>%
  dplyr::rename(GrowthCO2ppm = CO2) %>%
  dplyr::select(Species, GrowthCO2ppm, 
                Abs_at_Ambient_Cm_Mean, 
                Gly_Shuttle_Rate_Mean, 
                g_bs_Mean, 
                V_cmax_Mean, 
                L_Mean,
                C_bs_Mean)

# --- 5. MERGE ALL TRAITS ---
table_alltraits <- anatomy_clean %>%
  dplyr::full_join(biochem_clean, by = c("Species", "GrowthCO2ppm")) %>%
  dplyr::full_join(cstar_clean, by = c("Species", "GrowthCO2ppm")) %>%
  dplyr::full_join(model_clean, by = c("Species", "GrowthCO2ppm")) %>%
  full_join(photosynthetic_types) %>% 
  group_by(PhotosyntheticType, GrowthCO2ppm) %>%
  dplyr::select(!c(Genus, Family)) %>%
  summarise(across(.cols = !Species,
                   .fns = list(Mean = mean,
                               SE = ~sd(.)/sqrt(length(.)))))

# Create formatted table with mean ± SE
table_formatted <- table_alltraits %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    # Create column identifier
    Type_CO2 = paste0(PhotosyntheticType, "_", GrowthCO2ppm)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(-PhotosyntheticType, -GrowthCO2ppm) %>%
  # Transpose so each Type_CO2 becomes a column
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = -Type_CO2,
    names_to = "Trait",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = Type_CO2,
    values_from = Value
  ) %>%
  # Separate Mean and SE rows
  mutate(
    Trait_base = stringr::str_remove(Trait, "_Mean$|_SE$"),
    Stat_type = if_else(stringr::str_detect(Trait, "_Mean$"), "Mean", "SE")
  ) %>%
  # Get Mean and SE side by side
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    id_cols = Trait_base,
    names_from = Stat_type,
    values_from = !c(Trait, Trait_base, Stat_type)
  ) %>%
  # Determine decimal places for each trait
  mutate(
    decimals = case_when(
      stringr::str_detect(Trait_base, "VacuolePARatio|VacuoleCircularity") ~ 2,
      stringr::str_detect(Trait_base, "BSFractionGDC") ~ 1,
      stringr::str_detect(Trait_base, "EdgeDist") ~ 2,
      stringr::str_detect(Trait_base, "DotsPerMito") ~ 0,
      stringr::str_detect(Trait_base, "Activity") ~ 1,   # mmol mol Chl-1 s-1
      stringr::str_detect(Trait_base, "V_cmax") ~ 0,
      stringr::str_detect(Trait_base, "InitialSlope") ~ 3,
      stringr::str_detect(Trait_base, "Gamma|GammaLowLight|Cstar") ~ 1,
      stringr::str_detect(Trait_base, "Rd") ~ 2,
      stringr::str_detect(Trait_base, "Abs_at_Ambient|Shuttle") ~ 2,
      stringr::str_detect(Trait_base, "g_bs") ~ 0,
      stringr::str_detect(Trait_base, "C_bs") ~ 0,
      stringr::str_detect(Trait_base, "^L_") ~ 2,
      stringr::str_detect(Trait_base, "^n(Mito|Chloro)") ~ 1,
      stringr::str_detect(Trait_base, "^Area(Mito|Chloro)") ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ 2
    )
  )

# Get all column groups (everything before _Mean or _SE)
all_cols <- names(table_formatted)
mean_cols <- all_cols[stringr::str_detect(all_cols, "_Mean$")]
type_co2_combos <- stringr::str_remove(mean_cols, "_Mean$")

# Create formatted columns
table_final <- table_formatted %>%
  dplyr::select(Trait = Trait_base, decimals)


for (combo in type_co2_combos) {
  mean_col <- paste0(combo, "_Mean")
  se_col <- paste0(combo, "_SE")
  
  table_final <- table_final %>%
    mutate(
      !!combo := sprintf(
        paste0("%.", decimals, "f ± %.", decimals, "f"),
        table_formatted[[mean_col]],
        table_formatted[[se_col]]
      )
    )
}

# Load stats

final_lme_table <- readr::read_csv("data/processed_data/lme_results_summary.csv") %>%
  mutate(Trait = stringr::str_replace(Trait, "AT", "-AT"),
         Trait = stringr::str_replace(Trait, "ME", "-ME"))

# Build a wide p-value lookup: one column per PhotosyntheticType
p_lookup <- final_lme_table %>%
  dplyr::select(Trait, PhotosyntheticType, p.value.one.sided) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = PhotosyntheticType,
    values_from = p.value.one.sided,
    names_prefix = "p_"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(Trait_base = Trait)

# Format p-values
format_p <- function(p) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(p) ~ "",
    p < 0.001 ~ "<0.001",
    p < 0.01  ~ formatC(p, format = "f", digits = 3),
    p < 0.10  ~ formatC(p, format = "f", digits = 3),
    TRUE      ~ formatC(p, format = "f", digits = 2)
  )
}

p_cols <- p_lookup %>%
  dplyr::mutate(across(starts_with("p_"), format_p))

# Join to main table
table_final_with_p <- table_final %>%
  dplyr::select(-decimals) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(p_cols, by = c("Trait" = "Trait_base"))

# Rename p columns for clarity
names(table_final_with_p) <- names(table_final_with_p) %>%
  stringr::str_replace("^p_C\\[3\\]$", "p_C3") %>%
  stringr::str_replace("^p_PK$", "p_PK") %>%
  stringr::str_replace("^p_`sub-`\\*C\\[2\\]$", "p_subC2") %>%
  stringr::str_replace("^p_C\\[2\\]$", "p_C2")

table_final_with_p <- table_final_with_p %>%
  dplyr::select(Trait,
                `C[3]_200`, `C[3]_800`, p_C3,
                PK_200, PK_800, p_PK,
                `\`sub-\`*C[2]_200`, `\`sub-\`*C[2]_800`, p_subC2,
                `C[2]_200`, `C[2]_800`, p_C2)

print(table_final_with_p, n = nrow(table_final_with_p))
writexl::write_xlsx(table_final_with_p, here::here("tables/phototype_all.xlsx"))
```
