# Table 2: Photosynthetic type differences

```{r table2_type_means, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
# ===================================================================
# TABLE 2: Photosynthetic type means with compact letter display.
# Display: raw arithmetic means ± SE across species (pooled over CO2)
# Inference: PGLS on species means (primary), LME on plant means (supporting)
# ===================================================================

library(ape)
library(nlme)
library(emmeans)
library(multcomp)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(readr)

# --- 1. COMPUTE SPECIES MEANS (pooled over CO2) ---
# Uses plme_alltraits already loaded from the Table 1 chunk

species_means <- plme_alltraits %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Species, PhotosyntheticType) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    across(all_of(traits_to_test$trait_name), ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Plant grand means (pooled over CO2) for LME
plant_grand_means <- lme_alltraits %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Species, Plant, PhotosyntheticType) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    across(all_of(lme_traits_to_test$trait_name), ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


# --- 2. TRAIT FORMATTING LOOKUP ---

trait_lookup_t2 <- tibble::tribble(
  ~trait,                  ~label,                                    ~category,          ~decimals,
  "Gamma_Mean",            "Gamma (umol mol-1)",                      "Gas exchange",      1,
  "GammaLowLight_Mean",    "Gamma250 (umol mol-1)",                   "Gas exchange",      1,
  "Cstar_Mean",            "Ci* (umol mol-1)",                        "Gas exchange",      1,
  "InitialSlope_Mean",     "Initial slope of A/Ci (mol m-2 s-1)",     "Gas exchange",      3,
  "Rd_Mean",               "Rd (umol m-2 s-1)",                       "Gas exchange",      2,
  "VacuolePARatio_Mean",   "Vacuole perimeter:area",                  "Ultrastructure",    2,
  "VacuoleCircularity_Mean","Vacuole circularity",                    "Ultrastructure",    2,
  "BSFractionGDC_Mean",    "BS % of GDC (%)",                         "Ultrastructure",    1,
  "AreaChloro_Mean",       "Chloroplast size (um2)",                   "Ultrastructure",    1,
  "nChloro_Mean",          "Chloroplast number (cell profile-1)",      "Ultrastructure",    1,
  "BSFractionChloroArea_Mean","BS % of chloro. area (%)",             "Ultrastructure",    1,
  "AreaMito_Mean",         "Mitochondria size (um2)",                  "Ultrastructure",    1,
  "nMito_Mean",            "Mitochondria number (cell profile-1)",     "Ultrastructure",    1,
  "BSFractionMitoArea_Mean","BS % of mito. area (%)",                 "Ultrastructure",    1,
  "ChloroMitoEdgeDist_Mean","Chloro.-mito. edge dist. (um)",          "Ultrastructure",    2,
  "MitoChloroEdgeDist_Mean","Mito.-chloro. edge dist. (um)",          "Ultrastructure",    2,
  "DotsPerMitoArea_Mean",  "BS gold particles per mito. area (um-2)", "Ultrastructure",    0,
  "DotsPerMitoAreaM_Mean", "M gold particles per mito. area (um-2)",  "Ultrastructure",    0,
  "ActivityAlaAT",         "Ala-AT (mmol mol Chl-1 s-1)",              "Enzyme activity",   1,
  "ActivityAspAT",         "Asp-AT (mmol mol Chl-1 s-1)",              "Enzyme activity",   1,
  "ActivityNADME",         "NAD-ME (mmol mol Chl-1 s-1)",              "Enzyme activity",   1,
  "ActivityNADPME",        "NADP-ME (mmol mol Chl-1 s-1)",             "Enzyme activity",   1,
  "ActivityPEPC",          "PEPC (mmol mol Chl-1 s-1)",                "Enzyme activity",   1,
  "Abs_at_Ambient_Cm_Mean","As (umol m-2 s-1)",                       "Modelled",          2,
  "Gly_Shuttle_Rate_Mean", "Glycine shuttle rate (umol m-2 s-1)",     "Modelled",          2,
  "g_bs_Mean",             "gbs (mmol m-2 s-1)",                      "Modelled",          0,
  "V_cmax_Mean",           "Vcmax (umol m-2 s-1)",                    "Modelled",          0,
  "L_Mean",                "L (umol m-2 s-1)",                        "Modelled",          2,
  "C_bs_Mean",             "Cbs (umol mol-1)",                        "Modelled",          0
)


# --- 3. HELPER: build display row from raw means + CLD letters ---

build_row <- function(trait_name, sp_dat, cld_df, dec,
                      type_levels, type_labels) {
  raw_means <- sp_dat %>%
    dplyr::group_by(PhotosyntheticType) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(raw_mean = mean(y, na.rm = TRUE),
                     raw_se = sd(y, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(dplyr::n()),
                     .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      cld_df %>% dplyr::select(PhotosyntheticType, .group),
      by = "PhotosyntheticType"
    )

  row_out <- tibble::tibble(Trait = trait_name)
  for (j in seq_along(type_levels)) {
    type_row <- raw_means %>%
      dplyr::filter(PhotosyntheticType == type_levels[j])
    if (nrow(type_row) == 1) {
      se_val <- ifelse(is.na(type_row$raw_se), 0, type_row$raw_se)
      letter_part <- ifelse(is.na(type_row$.group) | type_row$.group == "",
                            "", paste0(" ", type_row$.group))
      cell <- paste0(
        formatC(type_row$raw_mean, format = "f", digits = dec),
        " \u00b1 ",
        formatC(se_val, format = "f", digits = dec),
        letter_part
      )
    } else {
      cell <- ""
    }
    row_out[[type_labels[j]]] <- cell
  }
  return(row_out)
}


# --- 4. ANALYSIS LOOP ---

type_levels <- c("C[3]", "PK", "`sub-`*C[2]", "C[2]")
type_labels <- c("C3", "PK", "sub-C2", "C2")

pgls_results_list <- list()
lme_results_list_t2 <- list()

for (i in seq_len(nrow(trait_lookup_t2))) {

  trait <- trait_lookup_t2$trait[i]
  dec <- trait_lookup_t2$decimals[i]
  cat("Table 2 —", trait, "\n")

  # Display data: species means pooled over CO2
  sp_dat <- species_means %>%
    dplyr::select(Species, PhotosyntheticType, all_of(trait)) %>%
    na.omit() %>%
    dplyr::rename(y = all_of(trait))

  # ===============================================================
  # PGLS (PRIMARY): species means, corBrownian
  # ===============================================================

  keep_spp <- intersect(tree$tip.label, sp_dat$Species)
  if (length(keep_spp) < 4) {
    message("  Skipping PGLS for ", trait, " — too few species")
    next
  }
  pruned_tree <- ape::keep.tip(tree, keep_spp)
  sp_dat_pgls <- sp_dat %>% dplyr::filter(Species %in% keep_spp)

  if (length(unique(sp_dat_pgls$PhotosyntheticType)) < 2) next

  tryCatch({

    # --- fit BM, OU, Pagel; select lowest finite AIC ---
    fits <- list()
    aics <- c(BM = NA_real_, OU = NA_real_, Pagel = NA_real_)

    tryCatch({
      fits$BM <- nlme::gls(y ~ PhotosyntheticType,
        correlation = ape::corBrownian(phy = pruned_tree, form = ~ Species),
        data = sp_dat_pgls, method = "REML")
      aics["BM"] <- AIC(fits$BM)
    }, error = function(e) message("  BM failed for ", trait))

    tryCatch({
      fits$OU <- nlme::gls(y ~ PhotosyntheticType,
        correlation = ape::corMartins(1, phy = pruned_tree, form = ~ Species, fixed = FALSE),
        data = sp_dat_pgls, method = "REML")
      aics["OU"] <- AIC(fits$OU)
    }, error = function(e) message("  OU failed for ", trait))

    tryCatch({
      fits$Pagel <- nlme::gls(y ~ PhotosyntheticType,
        correlation = ape::corPagel(1, phy = pruned_tree, form = ~ Species, fixed = FALSE),
        data = sp_dat_pgls, method = "REML")
      aics["Pagel"] <- AIC(fits$Pagel)
    }, error = function(e) message("  Pagel failed for ", trait))

    valid <- aics[is.finite(aics)]
    if (length(valid) == 0) stop("no valid correlation structure")
    best_aic <- min(valid)

    # Parsimony (dAIC < 2): keep BM unless OU/Pagel beats it by > 2 AIC.
    # Mirrors the bivariate model selection; stabilises the n = 11 fits.
    if (!is.na(aics["BM"]) && aics["BM"] <= best_aic + 2) {
      best <- "BM"
    } else {
      alt  <- valid[names(valid) %in% c("OU", "Pagel")]
      best <- names(alt)[which.min(alt)]
    }
    fit_pgls <- fits[[best]]
    cat(sprintf("    corr structure: %s (dAIC vs BM = %.2f)\n",
                best, aics["BM"] - best_aic))

    aov_pgls <- anova(fit_pgls, type = "marginal")
    f_pgls <- aov_pgls["PhotosyntheticType", "F-value"]
    p_pgls <- aov_pgls["PhotosyntheticType", "p-value"]

    emm_pgls <- emmeans::emmeans(fit_pgls, ~ PhotosyntheticType)
    cld_pgls <- as.data.frame(
      multcomp::cld(emm_pgls, adjust = "fdr", Letters = letters)
    ) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(.group = trimws(.group))

    # Suppress if all same letter
    if (length(unique(cld_pgls$.group)) == 1) {
      cld_pgls$.group <- ""
    }

    row_pgls <- build_row(trait, sp_dat, cld_pgls, dec,
                          type_levels, type_labels)
    row_pgls$F_type <- round(f_pgls, 2)
    row_pgls$p_type <- ifelse(p_pgls < 0.001, "<0.001",
                              formatC(p_pgls, format = "f", digits = 3))
    row_pgls$category <- trait_lookup_t2$category[i]

    pgls_results_list[[trait]] <- row_pgls

  }, error = function(e) {
    message("  PGLS failed for ", trait, ": ", e$message)
  })


  # ===============================================================
  # LME (SUPPORTING): plant grand means, (1|Species)
  # ===============================================================

  # Map PGLS trait name to LME trait name
  lme_trait <- trait_name_lookup$lme_name[trait_name_lookup$plme_name == trait]
  if (length(lme_trait) == 0) next

  pl_dat <- plant_grand_means %>%
    dplyr::select(Species, PhotosyntheticType, all_of(lme_trait)) %>%
    na.omit() %>%
    dplyr::rename(y = all_of(lme_trait))

  if (length(unique(pl_dat$PhotosyntheticType)) < 2) next

  tryCatch({

    fit_lme <- nlme::lme(
      y ~ PhotosyntheticType,
      random = ~ 1 | Species,
      data = pl_dat,
      method = "REML"
    )

    aov_lme <- anova(fit_lme, type = "marginal")
    f_lme <- aov_lme["PhotosyntheticType", "F-value"]
    p_lme <- aov_lme["PhotosyntheticType", "p-value"]

    emm_lme <- emmeans::emmeans(fit_lme, ~ PhotosyntheticType)
    cld_lme <- as.data.frame(
      multcomp::cld(emm_lme, adjust = "fdr", Letters = letters)
    ) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(.group = trimws(.group))

    if (length(unique(cld_lme$.group)) == 1) {
      cld_lme$.group <- ""
    }

    row_lme <- build_row(trait, sp_dat, cld_lme, dec,
                         type_levels, type_labels)
    row_lme$F_type <- round(f_lme, 2)
    row_lme$p_type <- ifelse(p_lme < 0.001, "<0.001",
                             formatC(p_lme, format = "f", digits = 3))
    row_lme$category <- trait_lookup_t2$category[i]

    lme_results_list_t2[[trait]] <- row_lme

  }, error = function(e) {
    message("  LME failed for ", trait, ": ", e$message)
  })
}


# --- 5. ASSEMBLE TABLES ---

table2_pgls <- dplyr::bind_rows(pgls_results_list) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Trait = factor(Trait, levels = trait_lookup_t2$trait)) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Trait) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Trait = trait_lookup_t2$label[match(as.character(Trait),
                                                    trait_lookup_t2$trait)]) %>%
  dplyr::select(Trait, C3, PK, `sub-C2`, C2, F_type, p_type, category)

table2_lme <- dplyr::bind_rows(lme_results_list_t2) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Trait = factor(Trait, levels = trait_lookup_t2$trait)) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Trait) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Trait = trait_lookup_t2$label[match(as.character(Trait),
                                                    trait_lookup_t2$trait)]) %>%
  dplyr::select(Trait, C3, PK, `sub-C2`, C2, F_type, p_type, category)

cat("\n=== TABLE 2 (PGLS — primary) ===\n")
print(table2_pgls, n = nrow(table2_pgls))

cat("\n=== TABLE 2 (LME — supporting) ===\n")
print(table2_lme, n = nrow(table2_lme))

# Save
writexl::write_xlsx(
  list(PGLS = table2_pgls, LME = table2_lme),
  here::here("tables/table2_type_contrasts.xlsx")
)
readr::write_csv(table2_pgls, here::here("data/processed_data/table2_pgls.csv"))
readr::write_csv(table2_lme, here::here("data/processed_data/table2_lme.csv"))

cat("\nTable 2 saved (PGLS + LME sheets).\n")
```




# In-text statistics (not in tables)

```{r intext_stats, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
# ===================================================================
# MISCELLANEOUS STATISTICS QUOTED IN THE MAIN TEXT
# Contrasts reported in-line only, not in Tables 1-4.
# Inference matches Table 4: PLME on species means (primary),
# LME on plant grand means (supporting).
# Requires plme_alltraits, lme_alltraits, traits_to_test,
# lme_traits_to_test, trait_name_lookup and tree.
# ===================================================================

library(ape)
library(nlme)
library(emmeans)
library(dplyr)

# --- 1. Pooled photosynthetic-type grouping ---
# C3 and proto-Kranz pooled versus sub-C2 and C2 pooled.

pool_types <- function(x) {
  factor(ifelse(x %in% c("C[3]", "PK"), "C3-like", "C2-like"),
         levels = c("C3-like", "C2-like"))
}

intext_species_means <- plme_alltraits %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Species, PhotosyntheticType) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(across(all_of(traits_to_test$trait_name),
                          ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
                   .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(TypeGroup = pool_types(PhotosyntheticType))

intext_plant_means <- lme_alltraits %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Species, Plant, PhotosyntheticType) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(across(all_of(lme_traits_to_test$trait_name),
                          ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
                   .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(TypeGroup = pool_types(PhotosyntheticType))

# --- 2. Helper: pooled C3-like versus pooled C2-like contrast ---
# alternative = "greater" tests C2-like > C3-like; use "two.sided" for no direction.

intext_group_contrast <- function(plme_trait, label, units,
                                  digits = 1,
                                  alternative = c("greater", "less", "two.sided")) {

  alternative <- match.arg(alternative)
  lme_trait <- trait_name_lookup$lme_name[trait_name_lookup$plme_name == plme_trait]

  sp_dat <- intext_species_means %>%
    dplyr::select(Species, TypeGroup, y = all_of(plme_trait)) %>%
    na.omit() %>%
    as.data.frame()

  pl_dat <- intext_plant_means %>%
    dplyr::select(Species, TypeGroup, y = all_of(lme_trait)) %>%
    na.omit() %>%
    as.data.frame()

  # Raw species means per group, for the quoted values
  raw <- sp_dat %>%
    dplyr::group_by(TypeGroup) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(n_species = dplyr::n(),
                     mean = mean(y),
                     se = sd(y) / sqrt(dplyr::n()),
                     .groups = "drop")

  cat("\n===================================================================\n")
  cat(label, "— pooled C3 and proto-Kranz versus pooled sub-C2 and C2\n")
  cat("===================================================================\n")
  for (k in seq_len(nrow(raw))) {
    cat(sprintf("  %-8s n = %d species, mean = %.*f +/- %.*f %s\n",
                as.character(raw$TypeGroup[k]), raw$n_species[k],
                digits, raw$mean[k], digits, raw$se[k], units))
  }

  # --- PLME (primary): species means, AIC selection among BM, OU, Pagel ---
  keep_spp <- intersect(tree$tip.label, sp_dat$Species)
  pruned_tree <- ape::keep.tip(tree, keep_spp)
  d_pgls <- sp_dat[sp_dat$Species %in% keep_spp, ]

  fits <- list()
  aics <- c(BM = NA_real_, OU = NA_real_, Pagel = NA_real_)

  tryCatch({
    fits$BM <- nlme::gls(y ~ TypeGroup,
      correlation = ape::corBrownian(phy = pruned_tree, form = ~ Species),
      data = d_pgls, method = "REML")
    aics["BM"] <- AIC(fits$BM)
  }, error = function(e) message("  BM failed"))

  tryCatch({
    fits$OU <- nlme::gls(y ~ TypeGroup,
      correlation = ape::corMartins(1, phy = pruned_tree, form = ~ Species, fixed = FALSE),
      data = d_pgls, method = "REML")
    aics["OU"] <- AIC(fits$OU)
  }, error = function(e) message("  OU failed"))

  tryCatch({
    fits$Pagel <- nlme::gls(y ~ TypeGroup,
      correlation = ape::corPagel(1, phy = pruned_tree, form = ~ Species, fixed = FALSE),
      data = d_pgls, method = "REML")
    aics["Pagel"] <- AIC(fits$Pagel)
  }, error = function(e) message("  Pagel failed"))

  valid <- aics[is.finite(aics)]
  best_aic <- min(valid)
  if (!is.na(aics["BM"]) && aics["BM"] <= best_aic + 2) {
    best <- "BM"
  } else {
    alt <- valid[names(valid) %in% c("OU", "Pagel")]
    best <- names(alt)[which.min(alt)]
  }
  fit_pgls <- fits[[best]]

  aov_pgls <- anova(fit_pgls, type = "marginal")
  ct_pgls <- as.data.frame(emmeans::contrast(
    emmeans::emmeans(fit_pgls, ~ TypeGroup, data = d_pgls),
    method = list("C2like_minus_C3like" = c(-1, 1))))
  # df.residual() returns NULL for gls; take the df emmeans used for its t-ratio
  df_pgls <- if (is.numeric(ct_pgls$df)) as.integer(round(ct_pgls$df)) else
    as.integer(nrow(d_pgls) - length(stats::coef(fit_pgls)))
  p1_pgls <- switch(alternative,
                    greater  = stats::pt(ct_pgls$t.ratio, df_pgls, lower.tail = FALSE),
                    less     = stats::pt(ct_pgls$t.ratio, df_pgls, lower.tail = TRUE),
                    two.sided = ct_pgls$p.value)

  cat(sprintf("\n  PLME (%s): F(%d,%d) = %.2f, P = %.4f\n",
              best, aov_pgls["TypeGroup", "numDF"], df_pgls,
              aov_pgls["TypeGroup", "F-value"], aov_pgls["TypeGroup", "p-value"]))
  cat(sprintf("    contrast C2-like - C3-like = %.*f +/- %.*f %s, t = %.2f, P(%s) = %.4f\n",
              digits, ct_pgls$estimate, digits, ct_pgls$SE, units,
              ct_pgls$t.ratio, alternative, p1_pgls))
  cat(sprintf("    dAIC: BM %.2f, OU %.2f, Pagel %.2f\n",
              aics["BM"] - best_aic, aics["OU"] - best_aic, aics["Pagel"] - best_aic))

  # --- LME (supporting): plant grand means, random intercept for species ---
  fit_lme <- nlme::lme(y ~ TypeGroup, random = ~ 1 | Species,
                       data = pl_dat, method = "REML")
  aov_lme <- anova(fit_lme, type = "marginal")
  ct_lme <- as.data.frame(emmeans::contrast(
    emmeans::emmeans(fit_lme, ~ TypeGroup, data = pl_dat),
    method = list("C2like_minus_C3like" = c(-1, 1))))
  p1_lme <- switch(alternative,
                   greater  = stats::pt(ct_lme$t.ratio, ct_lme$df, lower.tail = FALSE),
                   less     = stats::pt(ct_lme$t.ratio, ct_lme$df, lower.tail = TRUE),
                   two.sided = ct_lme$p.value)

  cat(sprintf("\n  LME: F(%d,%d) = %.2f, P = %.4f\n",
              aov_lme["TypeGroup", "numDF"], aov_lme["TypeGroup", "denDF"],
              aov_lme["TypeGroup", "F-value"], aov_lme["TypeGroup", "p-value"]))
  cat(sprintf("    contrast C2-like - C3-like = %.*f +/- %.*f %s, t = %.2f, P(%s) = %.4f\n",
              digits, ct_lme$estimate, digits, ct_lme$SE, units,
              ct_lme$t.ratio, alternative, p1_lme))

  # --- In-line sentence ---
  cat(sprintf(
    "\n  IN-TEXT: %s averaged %.*f +/- %.*f %s in the %d C3 and proto-Kranz species and %.*f +/- %.*f %s in the %d sub-C2 and C2 species (PLME: F(%d,%d) = %.2f, P = %s; LME: F(%d,%d) = %.2f, P = %s).\n",
    label,
    digits, raw$mean[raw$TypeGroup == "C3-like"], digits, raw$se[raw$TypeGroup == "C3-like"], units,
    raw$n_species[raw$TypeGroup == "C3-like"],
    digits, raw$mean[raw$TypeGroup == "C2-like"], digits, raw$se[raw$TypeGroup == "C2-like"], units,
    raw$n_species[raw$TypeGroup == "C2-like"],
    aov_pgls["TypeGroup", "numDF"], df_pgls, aov_pgls["TypeGroup", "F-value"],
    ifelse(aov_pgls["TypeGroup", "p-value"] < 0.001, "< 0.001",
           formatC(aov_pgls["TypeGroup", "p-value"], format = "f", digits = 3)),
    aov_lme["TypeGroup", "numDF"], aov_lme["TypeGroup", "denDF"], aov_lme["TypeGroup", "F-value"],
    ifelse(aov_lme["TypeGroup", "p-value"] < 0.001, "< 0.001",
           formatC(aov_lme["TypeGroup", "p-value"], format = "f", digits = 3))))

  invisible(list(raw = raw, pgls = fit_pgls, lme = fit_lme,
                 contrast_pgls = ct_pgls, contrast_lme = ct_lme,
                 corr_structure = best))
}

# --- 3. Ala-AT activity ---

intext_alaat <- intext_group_contrast(
  plme_trait  = "ActivityAlaAT",
  label       = "Ala-AT activity",
  units       = "mmol mol Chl-1 s-1",
  digits      = 1,
  alternative = "greater")
```


# Sensitivity analysis forest plots (Extended Data Fig.)

```{r sensitivity_forest, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 7.5}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

# --- 1. Load data ---
all_fits <- readr::read_csv(here::here("fit_results_ALL_COMBINATIONS.csv")) %>%
  filter(Status == "SUCCESS") %>%
  full_join(photosynthetic_types) %>%
  mutate(PhotosyntheticType = factor(PhotosyntheticType,
           levels = c("C[3]", "PK", "`sub-`*C[2]", "C[2]")))

# --- 2. Species means per CO2 x g_m x f_Rdh, then relative difference ---
species_means <- all_fits %>%
  group_by(Species, PhotosyntheticType, CO2_Growth, g_m_used, f_Rdh_used) %>%
  summarise(
    g_bs        = mean(g_bs_Value * 1000, na.rm = TRUE),        # mol -> mmol
    V_cmax      = mean(V_cmax_Value, na.rm = TRUE),
    Gly_Shuttle = mean(Gly_Shuttle_Rate_Value, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(g_bs, V_cmax, Gly_Shuttle),
               names_to = "Parameter", values_to = "Value") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = CO2_Growth, values_from = Value,
              names_prefix = "CO2_") %>%
  mutate(
    midpoint = (CO2_200 + CO2_800) / 2,
    rel_diff = (CO2_200 - CO2_800) / abs(midpoint) * 100
  ) %>%
  filter(is.finite(rel_diff))

# --- 3. Photosynthetic-type summaries (mean +/- SE) ---
# Facet labels are plotmath strings; parameter strips carry no units because
# every panel is plotted as a relative difference (%).
type_summary <- species_means %>%
  group_by(PhotosyntheticType, Parameter, g_m_used, f_Rdh_used) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_rd = mean(rel_diff, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_rd   = sd(rel_diff, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    n       = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    f_Rdh_factor = factor(f_Rdh_used, levels = c(0, 0.1, 0.2)),
    Parameter    = factor(Parameter,
                          levels = c("g_bs", "V_cmax", "Gly_Shuttle"),
                          labels = c("italic(g)[bs]",
                                     "italic(V)[cmax]",
                                     "Glycine~shuttle~rate")),
    g_m_label    = factor(g_m_used,
                          levels = sort(unique(g_m_used)),
                          labels = paste0("italic(g)[m] == ",
                                          sort(unique(g_m_used))))
  )

# --- 4. Panel letters (a-i), read across rows ---
panel_letters <- type_summary %>%
  distinct(g_m_label, Parameter) %>%
  arrange(g_m_label, Parameter) %>%
  mutate(label = paste0("(", letters[seq_len(n())], ")"))

# --- 5. Plot: rows = g_m, columns = parameter ---
frdh_labels <- c(expression(italic(f)[Rdh] == 0),
                 expression(italic(f)[Rdh] == 0.1),
                 expression(italic(f)[Rdh] == 0.2))

sensitivity_forest_plot <- type_summary %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = mean_rd, y = PhotosyntheticType,
             fill = f_Rdh_factor, shape = f_Rdh_factor)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed",
             linewidth = 0.25, colour = "grey50") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = mean_rd - se_rd, xmax = mean_rd + se_rd),
                orientation = "y",
                linetype = "solid",
                linewidth = 0.25,
                width = 0.1,
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.6)) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5, position = position_dodge(width = 0.6)) +
  geom_text(aes(x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = label),
            data = panel_letters,
            inherit.aes = FALSE,
            hjust = -0.4, vjust = 1.4, size = 3.5, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(21, 24, 22), labels = frdh_labels) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("white", "grey60", "black"), labels = frdh_labels) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = function(x) parse(text = x)) +
  labs(x = expression("Relative difference between low versus high CO"[2]~"growth (%)"),
       fill = NULL, shape = NULL) +
  cowplot::panel_border(size = 0.5, color = "black") +
  theme(axis.title.y  = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "top",
        legend.text.align = 0,
        strip.text = element_text(size = 10)) +
  facet_grid(g_m_label ~ Parameter, scales = "free_x", labeller = label_parsed)

print(sensitivity_forest_plot)

ggsave(here::here("figures", "sensitivity_forest_plots.jpg"),
       sensitivity_forest_plot,
       width = 7.5, height = 7, bg = "white", dpi = 500)
```

# Supplementary Table: LME vs PLME comparison

```{r supp_table_lme_plme}
library(dplyr)
# Helper for p-value formatting
format_p <- function(p) {
  case_when(
    p < 0.001 ~ "< 0.001",
    p < 0.01  ~ formatC(p, format = "f", digits = 3),
    TRUE      ~ formatC(p, format = "f", digits = 3)
  )
}
# --- 1. Load data ---
comp <- readr::read_csv(here::here("data/processed_data/plme_vs_lme_comparison.csv")) %>%
  mutate(signif = tidyr::replace_na(signif, ""))

# --- 2. Readable trait names and grouping ---
trait_lookup <- tibble::tribble(
  ~Trait,                        ~Trait_Label,                          ~Category,          ~Direction,          ~Order,
  "Gamma_Mean",                  "Gamma",                               "Gas exchange",     "lower at 200",       1,
  "GammaLowLight_Mean",         "Gamma250",                            "Gas exchange",     "lower at 200",       2,
  "Cstar_Mean",                  "Ci*",                                 "Gas exchange",     "lower at 200",       3,
  "InitialSlope_Mean",           "Initial slope of A/Ci",               "Gas exchange",     "greater at 200",     3.5,
  "Rd_Mean",                     "Rd",                                  "Gas exchange",     "two-sided",          4,
  "VacuolePARatio_Mean",        "Vacuole P:A",                         "Ultrastructure",   "lower at 200"  ,          5,
  "VacuoleCircularity_Mean",    "Vacuole circularity",                 "Ultrastructure",   "greater at 200",          6,
  "BSFractionGDC_Mean",         "BS fraction of GDC (%)",              "Ultrastructure",   "greater at 200",     7,
  "BSFractionChloroArea_Mean",  "BS fraction of chloro. area (%)",     "Ultrastructure",   "greater at 200",     8,
  "BSFractionMitoArea_Mean",    "BS fraction of mito. area (%)",       "Ultrastructure",   "greater at 200",     9,
  "ChloroMitoEdgeDist_Mean",    "Chloro.-mito. edge distance (um)",    "Ultrastructure",   "lower at 200",      10,
  "MitoChloroEdgeDist_Mean",    "Mito.-chloro. edge distance (um)",    "Ultrastructure",   "lower at 200",      11,
  "DotsPerMitoArea_Mean",       "BS gold particle density (um-2)",     "Ultrastructure",   "greater at 200",    12,
  "DotsPerMitoAreaM_Mean",      "M gold particle density (um-2)",      "Ultrastructure",   "lower at 200",      13,
  "nChloro_Mean",               "BS chloroplast count",                "Ultrastructure",   "greater at 200",    13.1,
  "nMito_Mean",                 "BS mitochondria count",               "Ultrastructure",   "greater at 200",    13.2,
  "AreaChloro_Mean",            "BS chloroplast area (um2)",           "Ultrastructure",   "greater at 200",    13.3,
  "AreaMito_Mean",              "BS mitochondria area (um2)",          "Ultrastructure",   "greater at 200",    13.4,
  "ActivityAspAT",             "Asp-AT activity",                     "Enzyme activity",  "greater at 200",    14,
  "ActivityAlaAT",             "Ala-AT activity",                     "Enzyme activity",  "greater at 200",    15,
  "ActivityNADME",             "NAD-ME activity",                     "Enzyme activity",  "greater at 200",    16,
  "ActivityNADPME",            "NADP-ME activity",                    "Enzyme activity",  "greater at 200",    17,
  "ActivityPEPC",               "PEPC activity",                       "Enzyme activity",  "greater at 200",    18,
  "Abs_at_Ambient_Cm_Mean",     "As",                                  "Modelled",         "greater at 200",    19,
  "Gly_Shuttle_Rate_Mean",      "Glycine shuttle rate",                "Modelled",         "greater at 200",    20,
  "g_bs_Mean",                  "gbs",                                 "Modelled",         "lower at 200",      21,
  "V_cmax_Mean",                "Vcmax",                               "Modelled",         "greater at 200",    22,
  "L_Mean",                     "Leakage rate (L)",                    "Modelled",         "lower at 200",      23,
  "C_bs_Mean",                  "Cbs",                                 "Modelled",         "greater at 200",    24
)

# Readable photosynthetic type labels
type_lookup <- tibble::tribble(
  ~PhotosyntheticType,  ~Type_Label,  ~Type_Order,
  "C[3]",              "C3",          1,
  "PK",                "PK",          2,
  "`sub-`*C[2]",       "sub-C2",      3,
  "C[2]",              "C2",          4
)
# --- 3. Pivot to wide: one row per Trait × Type ---
lme_df <- comp %>%
  dplyr::filter(Model == "LME") %>%
  dplyr::select(Trait, PhotosyntheticType, estimate, SE, df, t.ratio, p.one.sided, signif) %>%
  rename_with(~ paste0("LME_", .), .cols = c(estimate, SE, df, t.ratio, p.one.sided, signif))

plme_df <- comp %>%
  dplyr::filter(Model == "PLME_BM") %>%
  dplyr::select(Trait, PhotosyntheticType, estimate, SE, df, t.ratio, p.one.sided, signif) %>%
  rename_with(~ paste0("PLME_", .), .cols = c(estimate, SE, df, t.ratio, p.one.sided, signif))

wide <- lme_df %>%
  left_join(plme_df, by = c("Trait", "PhotosyntheticType")) %>%
  left_join(trait_lookup, by = "Trait") %>%
  left_join(type_lookup, by = "PhotosyntheticType") %>%
  mutate(Agreement = if_else(LME_signif == PLME_signif, "Yes", "No")) %>%
  arrange(Order, Type_Order)

# --- 4. Format for display ---
supp_table <- wide %>%
  transmute(
    Category,
    Trait      = Trait_Label,
    `Phot. type` = Type_Label,
    Direction,
    `LME est.` = round(LME_estimate, 3),
    `LME SE`   = round(LME_SE, 3),
    `LME df`   = round(LME_df, 0),
    `LME t`    = round(LME_t.ratio, 2),
    `LME p`    = format_p(LME_p.one.sided),
    `PLME est.` = round(PLME_estimate, 3),
    `PLME SE`   = round(PLME_SE, 3),
    `PLME df`   = round(PLME_df, 0),
    `PLME t`    = round(PLME_t.ratio, 2),
    `PLME p`    = format_p(PLME_p.one.sided),
    Agreement
  )

# Helper for p-value formatting
format_p <- function(p) {
  case_when(
    p < 0.001 ~ "< 0.001",
    p < 0.01  ~ formatC(p, format = "f", digits = 3),
    TRUE      ~ formatC(p, format = "f", digits = 3)
  )
}

# Re-run transmute with the helper defined
supp_table <- wide %>%
  transmute(
    Category,
    Trait        = Trait_Label,
    `Phot. type` = Type_Label,
    Direction,
    `LME est.`   = round(LME_estimate, 3),
    `LME SE`     = round(LME_SE, 3),
    `LME df`     = round(LME_df, 0),
    `LME t`      = round(LME_t.ratio, 2),
    `LME p`      = format_p(LME_p.one.sided),
    `PLME est.`  = round(PLME_estimate, 3),
    `PLME SE`    = round(PLME_SE, 3),
    `PLME df`    = round(PLME_df, 0),
    `PLME t`     = round(PLME_t.ratio, 2),
    `PLME p`     = format_p(PLME_p.one.sided),
    Agreement
  )

# --- 5. Summary stats ---
n_total     <- nrow(supp_table)
n_agree     <- sum(supp_table$Agreement == "Yes")
n_disagree  <- sum(supp_table$Agreement == "No")
agree_pct   <- round(n_agree / n_total * 100, 1)

cat(glue::glue("Agreement: {n_agree}/{n_total} ({agree_pct}%). Disagreements: {n_disagree}."))

# ===================================================================
# KEY RESULTS TO PASTE (cross-check vs text, Table 1, Table 3, Supp Table 2)
# Rd is now two-sided; L is now one-sided lower-at-200.
# Requires the two upstream loop chunks + the PLME-vs-LME chunk to have been
# re-run first, so plme_vs_lme_comparison.csv reflects the corrected directions.
# ===================================================================
cat("\n\n================= KEY RESULTS (paste this) =================\n")
cat(sprintf("\nLME vs PLME agreement: %d / %d (%.1f%%). Disagreements: %d.\n",
            n_agree, n_total, agree_pct, n_disagree))

cat("\n---- Disagreements (Trait x Type) ----\n")
disagreements <- wide %>%
  dplyr::filter(Agreement == "No") %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    Category, Trait = Trait_Label, Type = Type_Label, Direction,
    LME_p  = round(LME_p.one.sided, 3),
    PLME_p = round(PLME_p.one.sided, 3),
    Sig_in = dplyr::case_when(
      LME_signif == "*"  & PLME_signif != "*" ~ "LME only",

    )

  dplyr::arrange(Category, Trait, Type)
print(as.data.frame(disagreements), row.names = FALSE)

  dplyr::filter(Trait %in% c("Rd_Mean", "L_Mean")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Type = factor(Type_Label, levels = c("C3", "PK", "sub-C2", "C2"))) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Trait_Label, Type) %>%
  dplyr::transmute(

    LME_est = round(LME_estimate, 3), LME_t = round(LME_t.ratio, 2),
    LME_p   = round(LME_p.one.sided, 3),  LME_sig  = LME_signif,
    PLME_p  = round(PLME_p.one.sided, 3), PLME_sig = PLME_signif

cat("\n---- Full LME vs PLME table (all 28 traits x 4 types) ----\n")

cat("\n============================================================\n")

    caption = paste0(

      "One-sided p-values are reported where the direction of effect was predicted ",

      "Disagreements between the two models are indicated in the Agreement column.",
      "",

library(openxlsx)

wb <- createWorkbook()
addWorksheet(wb, "LME vs PLME")

# Title row
writeData(wb, 1, paste0(
  "Supplementary Table X | Comparison of LME and PLME contrasts for CO2 ",
  "treatment effects (200 vs 800 µmol mol-1) within each ",
  "photosynthetic type. Agreement: ", n_agree, "/", n_total, " (", agree_pct, "%). ",
  "Disagreements between the two models are indicated in the Agreement column.",
  ""
), startRow = 1)
mergeCells(wb, 1, cols = 1:ncol(supp_table), rows = 1)
addStyle(wb, 1, createStyle(fontSize = 10, fontName = "Arial", wrapText = TRUE), rows = 1, cols = 1)

# Header
header_style <- createStyle(
  textDecoration = "bold", fontSize = 10, fontName = "Arial",
  border = "bottom", borderStyle = "thin", halign = "center"
)
writeData(wb, 1, supp_table, startRow = 3)
addStyle(wb, 1, header_style, rows = 3, cols = 1:ncol(supp_table), gridExpand = TRUE)

# Body
body_style <- createStyle(fontSize = 10, fontName = "Arial")
data_rows <- 4:(nrow(supp_table) + 3)
addStyle(wb, 1, body_style, rows = data_rows, cols = 1:ncol(supp_table), gridExpand = TRUE)

# Bold significant p-values
sig_lme <- which(supp_table$`LME p` != format_p(1) & grepl("\\*|< 0.001|0\\.0[0-4]", supp_table$`LME p`))
sig_plme <- which(supp_table$`PLME p` != format_p(1) & grepl("\\*|< 0.001|0\\.0[0-4]", supp_table$`PLME p`))

# Simpler: bold rows where LME or PLME is significant
lme_p_col  <- which(names(supp_table) == "LME p")
plme_p_col <- which(names(supp_table) == "PLME p")

bold_style <- createStyle(fontSize = 10, fontName = "Arial", textDecoration = "bold")
for (r in data_rows) {
  row_idx <- r - 3
  if (row_idx <= nrow(supp_table)) {
    lme_val  <- wide$LME_p.one.sided[row_idx]
    plme_val <- wide$PLME_p.one.sided[row_idx]
    if (!is.na(lme_val) && lme_val < 0.05) addStyle(wb, 1, bold_style, rows = r, cols = lme_p_col)
    if (!is.na(plme_val) && plme_val < 0.05) addStyle(wb, 1, bold_style, rows = r, cols = plme_p_col)
  }
}

# Highlight disagreement rows in light yellow
disagree_rows <- which(supp_table$Agreement == "No") + 3
highlight <- createStyle(fontSize = 10, fontName = "Arial", fgFill = "#FFF2CC")
if (length(disagree_rows) > 0) {
  addStyle(wb, 1, highlight, rows = disagree_rows, cols = 1:ncol(supp_table), gridExpand = TRUE)
}

# Category separator: light grey fill on first row of each new category
cat_starts <- which(!duplicated(supp_table$Category)) + 3
cat_fill <- createStyle(fontSize = 10, fontName = "Arial", fgFill = "#F0F0F0")
addStyle(wb, 1, cat_fill, rows = cat_starts, cols = 1:ncol(supp_table), gridExpand = TRUE)

# Column widths
setColWidths(wb, 1, cols = 1, widths = 16)                          # Category
setColWidths(wb, 1, cols = 2, widths = 28)                          # Trait
setColWidths(wb, 1, cols = 3, widths = 10)                          # Phot. type
setColWidths(wb, 1, cols = 4, widths = 14)                          # Direction
setColWidths(wb, 1, cols = 5:14, widths = 11)                       # Numeric cols
setColWidths(wb, 1, cols = 15, widths = 11)                         # Agreement

# Freeze header
freezePane(wb, 1, firstActiveRow = 4)

# Save
dir.create(here::here("tables"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
saveWorkbook(wb, here::here("tables", "supp_table_lme_vs_plme.xlsx"), overwrite = TRUE)
```
